Do you know what a “tracker” is? I had never heard the term until after I decided to first run for office against Lauren Boebert in 2022.
“Trackers” are essentially professional stalkers – the political version of paparazzi. They’re paid by Super PACs or groups funded by the Koch brothers to follow you around with a video camera everywhere you go. Often, they yell ridiculous questions and try to get you to say something that they can then edit up and spin into a fake scandal or put in attack ads.
Well, the first tracker of the campaign has begun showing up to my events with voters – recording every word I say and every breath I take.
This is going to be one of the closest and most important races on Election Night. In 2022, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes.
We can win this critical House seat, but the Super PACs are coming after me. They know how close this race is going to be – especially now that Lauren Boebert has run off scared.

I had never heard the term until after I decided to first run for office against Lauren Boebert in 2022. “Trackers” are essentially professional stalkers – the political version of paparazzi. Often, they yell ridiculous questions and try to get you to say something that they can then edit up and spin into a fake scandal or put in attack ads. I continue to be eternally grateful for your support in my run for Congress during the Special election of 2017. Whenever I’m out I’m humbled when I meet Montanans asking me if I would consider running again. On that note, I have a big announcement to make. I may not be running but it’s the next best thing. .
My son, Guthrie Quist, is running for our local legislative seat in order to help overturn the Supermajority in the Legislature. We only need to pick up a few seats to stop all those unconstitutional bills in their tracks. But he needs your help! He’s running against a lifelong Charter School advocate from Florida with a massive campaign war chest from out of state donors. Let’s even the playing field and send Guthrie to Helena for you and get the Legislature working for Montana Families again.
Guthrie worked incredibly hard on my campaign and then several other Congressional Campaigns in Wyoming and New Hampshire as a campaign consultant and has emerged as a young leader in our community. Please consider donating to his campaign if you are able. Also stay tuned for his Award Winning Documentary about my race, “Bodyslammed: Folk Hero vs. Billionaire” coming to a streamer on your device.
All My Best,Rob Quist

In Tuesday's election, there were huge wins at all levels of the ballot throughout the state! From the two amendment questions passage which ban Zuckerbucks in Wisconsin, President Trump's resounding victory in the GOP primary, and down to conservative candidates for local office: it was a good night to be a Republican in Wisconsin! **Trump Rally in Green Bay**
The Republican Party of Wisconsin welcomed President Trump to Green Bay on Tuesday where he hosted a rally at the convention center. **Monroe County**
The Republican Party of Monroe County has continuously hosted their conservative breakfasts. Their last breakfast hosted Representative Nancy VanderMeer and John Christy who spoke about the new legislative district maps and the potential challenges and opportunities, as we persevere to save Wisconsin and America. **Calumet County**
The Republican Party of Calumet County hosted a membership meeting and were joined by Wisconsin assembly members and others. **St. Croix County**
The Republican Party of St. Croix County has stayed busy these last two weeks. On March 23, the party hosted their county caucus, and on March 28, they held a membership forum on public safety in St. Croix. **Brown County**
The Republican Party of Brown County hosted an incredible Lincoln-Reagan Day Dinner, joined by Senate candidate Eric Hovde and others. **Kenosha County**
The Republican Party of Kenosha County organized multiple fun events in the past few weeks. First, they had their Lincoln Day Dinner with special guest Lindsey Graham. Next, they hosted a 'Patriot Barbie' event to honor strong women leadership in the Republican Party. **Kenosha County**
Moreover, Kenosha County hosted a Gun Show and has continued to put on their Super Saturdays in preparation for election day! **Washington County**
The Republican Party of Washington County hosted a Pints & Politics last week. Tons of members showed up to hear from their guest speaker and chair. **Outagamie County**
The Republican Party of Outagamie County hosted a multitude of door-knocking campaigns to encourage Outagamie citizens to get out and vote on April 2! **Green County**
The Republican Party of Green County was joined by State Senator Steve Nass and members of the Wisconsin United for Freedom at their event supporitng conservative candidates! **Richland County**
The Republican Party of Richland County hosted their annual Lincoln Day Dinner and were joined by some of Wisconsin's finest, including Congressman Derrick Van Orden. Guests were able to meet and greet with Richland County's Sheriff and local representatives. **Milwaukee County**
The Republican Party of Milwaukee County's North Shore members hosted an amazing 'We the People' Event. The night was a huge success and hundreds of patriots showed up to offer their support. **Rusk County**
The Republican Party of Rusk County were joined by Chairman Brian Schimming and Congressman Tom Tiffany at their annual Lincoln Day Dinner. **Waupaca County**
The Republican Party of Waupaca County hosted their Lincoln-Reagan-Trump Day Dinner; the event was a huge success and members did a great job decorating the room! name: Dr. Cornel West for President 2024
subject: Enough! End the Genocide Now — A Heartfelt Call from Dr. Cornel West
body:
Join the only Presidential Campaign confronting American Imperialism to end the genocide in Palestine.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/progressive_courage_2024?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=enough_end_the_genocide_now&n=1)
---
Dear Peter,
### I urgently invite you to join the only presidential campaign confronting American Imperialism to END the genocide in Palestine.
While over one million people are starving from Gaza to Rafah—Congress has passed legislation to _defund_ the region's largest source of humanitarian aid. **While our tax dollars build the bombs that fall indiscriminately on communities corralled by a vicious Israeli occupation, our politicians remain silent.** The choices we make today will shape the future for generations to come. Will we continue to support American imperialism and turn a blind eye to the genocide in Palestine—or will we stand up and demand change? **Will we not only take to the streets but will we exercise our power by changing our votes?**
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/say_no_to_genocide_2024?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=enough_end_the_genocide_now&n=2 "END THE GENOCIDE — DONATE NOW") [END THE GENOCIDE — DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/say_no_to_genocide_2024?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=enough_end_the_genocide_now&n=2)
---
### **I am writing to ask you to join me in the fight against injustice and oppression.**
For over 40 years, I have been a steadfast advocate for peace, justice, and human rights. I have stood with the Palestinian people in their struggle for freedom and equality, and I have spoken out against American militarism and imperialism around the world. As your candidate for president, I am committed to dismantling the American empire and ending our complicity in these atrocities against innocent people. I will not rest until we recalibrate our society to value human life over corporate profit, our shared humanity over global imperialism.

**But I cannot do this alone**. I need your support to take this message to every corner of our nation.

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32755%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6z5V5CyyUi0YTZxUOYLBcg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32756%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1FRQPhgqcuen4tJjDPGXVA&sysid=1) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: I hope you’ll join us
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfq0kjcroqo74k610jf4us9lf0ggk5jlg1h1t5a0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cpi6cp76c3h2bs)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z44o9nm72mr4u1s0mphv7j0cujpvb6njseg8vdog_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cpi6cp76c3h2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

body:
Support Biden’s plan to tax billionaires and corporations. It’s time for them to pay their fair share just like working Americans. Add your name to support President Biden’s progressive tax plan >>
| | | | |
---
| | | | | _Please support this[new action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1837d88b-285c-41eb-949c-a2b3423893a4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) from our friends at Indivisible!_ Friends, President Biden said it best in his State of the Union Speech: “No billionaire should pay a lower federal tax rate than a teacher, a sanitation worker or a nurse." [**Click here to be automatically added as a supporter of Biden's plan to make billionaires and corporations pay their fair share.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbc298a74-c0d9-427c-a029-95d010c47b15/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Biden’s new plan is straightforward: Raise the corporate tax rate to 28% and make billionaires pay a 25% minimum income tax. From 2018-2022, 35 major US corporations (including major companies like Ford, Netflix, and Tesla) paid [$9.5 billion to executive officers while paying **negative** $1.8 billion](https://default.salsalabs.org/T99f35c79-c73a-4eef-a9b1-f4d62bbd2f0d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) in taxes. That’s right, NEGATIVE taxes. Meanwhile, the richest 0.01% of Americans pay only [around 8% in income taxes](https://default.salsalabs.org/T93f21e92-31a9-4a15-8c77-40dad6a9a87e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). This doesn’t add up: **Why are working Americans paying a higher tax rate than billionaires and corporations?** Ensuring billionaires and corporations pay their fair share would raise $440 billion over the next decade so we can invest in things that help all Americans like health care and education. [**If you think this sounds reasonable, add your name to support Biden’s plan to fairly tax billionaires and corporations >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td005a345-5bc2-4846-bf72-170401ac89be/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Republicans are pushing back on this plan because they know it targets their biggest donors. Too bad. It’s time to make those at the top pay their fair share.

"Tax cuts
for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower
tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy
Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the
federal government?

Hoover
Institution Senior Fellow Thomas Sowell takes an empirical
approach in his commentary, "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts
for the Rich."

real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all
actually lead to greater revenue for the government.

subject: Our course on the American Founding—Now on DVD
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdkcgbg3pra2r1q4epupu7ok37bb8lm9ujnj7cf8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cpi66or4cth2bs)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgb26kv5omgrfgsnc07hauuj80d59utdno5olsk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cpi66or4cth2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to launch the next, crucial
phase for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, Joe Biden, and Big Labor to bury the National
Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $500, $1,000,
and even more. For others, a contribution of $50 or $100 has been
as much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $1,000, $500,
$250, $100, or $50, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then give your contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to the National Right to Work
Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $500, $250, $100, or
$50 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive
program designed to mobilize public opposition to compulsory
unionism and, at the same time, enlist public support for Right
to Work legislation. The Committee's mailing address is 8001
Braddock Road, Springfield, Virginia 22160. The Committee can be
contacted toll-free at 1-800-325-7892. Its web address is
www.nrtwc.org

Not produced or e-mailed at taxpayer expense.

To help the National Right to Work Committee
grow, please forward this to a friend.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill. Now is the time to act. subject: Our course on the American Founding—Now on DVD
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/MsUR7uYLB2ZJ3nC8zDBpdQ~~/AARclAA~)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

## 'No Labels' Party Ends Its 2024 Run
The third-party group No Labels is ending [its 2024 presidential campaign efforts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL8Gd0TrNeCkoHiNu7z2SmsN63hPGCyDEuXvT7n66ilmNF_3-U6SJD_-086-rWWm0OTJs9FWo5lNF_3KjDx07PuxxwFN767d5t3NLDTCCC6OJq63sMIyDDFSvzATxU48AhowYOFmHdpLD2BChAHALdeld8oAR2nlvHwXyW3jNb3Lk89LKHuX_NbaUdXwT-GkcGobb5LShymctrJz5ldVOAXaD5JHVjgZO1qwqHPRiRZOVR90trc-qFau-pOjOXFoUrIOlKNEaqxw6k4fj5ekJNWNysBjJ_lVde2vJz8BAAD__zEoYoc) after failing to find a centrist candidate to lead the ticket. The group's decision comes a week after the death of former Sen. Joe Lieberman, a founding chairman. Over the months, the group considered Nikki Haley, Chris Christie, and former Maryland Gov. Larry Hogan as presidential candidates. With No Labels out of the race, [Robert F. Kennedy Jr. remains](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp_G3oguFy6QgaFLtnTtaGFzianwjzBNlLev3Lnjp284R-frPtxDLnl9fIaFfUvbEKaWnzxoQQL1oPvoEzOy6tlLK1Ghlsb1s0cFgZKDmKJBCSFZdw2O5JSIUWros0dADRoIrmSQLhJATxEUgBndKE2ngWNuW718b3ltM6fy3p5cL9O29MXPre1Hpz46vHV4C_vKr-O8zlFbngp3eFs3UcLI5RAnTLQ51yj2UNtbjDnyKlr9WXYxWW2tI8syRiBSpNCMzhEkTQBB9tXH_ZVLyYexnYbHEnL582j_RfkNAAD__xFmX0s) the only prominent outsider still seeking the presidency on a third-party ticket. Kennedy's on the ballot in five states so far.
## Deadly Storms Slam Midwest, East Coast
Severe storms smashed through several midwestern and eastern states Wednesday, killing two people in Pennsylvania and [leaving hundreds of thousands without power](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGPozAQBeBfYzrQeDwYUri4xl2uvRIZPA4-ERzZ3iD-_Ypoy21e9Unv6f27T3cXt7g__ronmxrS5JYa3zxR27dIEzXeBGZk1bCRg0SFJPXYrCZIkiPceB6dItSaUHt9o8A8IwT2TTQISEDQw63X2HcSgBYPCkDP4yy1IGAfa8rd_xT3unLYzvTm3C3p2WxmrfVVhPoj0Aq0x3F0X8XV5N15AYG21JRPgXbno1yCXV05C7RXr0ALn1CX5Ddnbn9Ee7DfuXh3tiFlXlypAu2g5KhJSoBBoG2y8a8jblssehAEj6eL22dY_e2l7wAAAP__9Z1lhQ). An estimated 361,000 households across West Virginia, Wisconsin, New York, and other states lost power, and tornadoes were reported in Indiana. A massive snowstorm struck Maine, leaving half the state without power and covered in snow. [See photos of Maine here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uwyAUQOGngY3ocsF_A0MXb-na0QL72iYC4wKJ1bev0rnzGT6dr_t0tz74Y_u0kUxd02Tn6l80adEI1JPmi1mJkBQnIzuJCrVse74bZzttFXRyGdCRctTNYHsHa48OGhy4NwioQUMDQ9Nic5MAel5AAbSud7JlGmjxNeXbI_mj7rSGn_SifJtT5MHstZ6FqQ-GI8Pxerjvd2A42jP7IMqRrlJTjuLNiGj9QeLcU01FnOmiLNKz2o3E8YyOcmE48myW8_Ih-NJ2TMMWrQ9_Wv1v_TcAAP__yJdapw). Pennsylvania was hit by high winds and heavy rains that brought down numerous trees, including the ones that killed two individuals. Severe weather is [expected to continue today](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvozAQhH-N6RyZtXGgoLiGLtdeiYxZwPeMF9mboPz7J1K86jVb7Mx8Gs2_x_hwIYa0_nU79rzQ6DyHF45GNhLMaKq5XxABdYV9fa9Bg6ltW2193aLtvLa6dU29AGo1ed9pCzN4C76rQg8KjDKqUV1jobnVShk_K62UndqptsIonANTvv2nkHjDJb7phfnmaa9ivzEfReg_AgYBQ3ofVPiSBAwXWMCgfs6zyIRnuXyU0RXGLKfoCn_-8k35S05UmJI8A2-SMx3BuygLU97lQtmjPEOa5fq8Qq7IkuiU0zMHLDJR5g1z-sAwrdGlWcBQ5X4-zhBjKPYujFp3F-KnPf825XcAAAD__73tdos).
## List: Ranking Median Income in Every State
A new ranking of states where workers earn the highest median income shows [Massachusetts at the top,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEbDYMNSuHgN3b42JTL2sDiy8cqeLOLvo02RKs1trnR0dD7uy92GGI7Hf5vI8JYX6zi8aFFSS1SLarzZiJD6hkw3dtij6oZbsxvS0I92Gv2op5XW0RIBus5rRGUn3JpgEFCBAg2THlC3HYByHnqAYb2t3SAUkA-cS_uZw8E7bfHKLyqty6mJZmd-VtH_EzgLnM_zbN2xuvcpcH6jBc7wO19VVrZMVZ47FZL0onJ5e0mbqARnjyrJlkPyTjLlyjLlg6525xSbYvzzDDGGOoxCwSPZEH8k-K8i3wEAAP__hIdhWw) followed by Washington. Other states in the top 10 include Alaska, Colorado, and Rhode Island. The median salaries in those ten states range from $60,690 in Massachusetts to $50,970 in Rhode Island. At the bottom of the scale, the 50th state is Mississippi, with a median income of $37,500. The data, compiled by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, considers income only, and not the cost of living in each state. [Here's an interactive map](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdEbDYMNSuHgN3b42JTL2sDiy8cqeLOLvo02RKs1trnR0dD7uy92GGI7Hf5vI8JYX6zi8aFFSS1SLarzZiJD6hkw3dtij6oZbsxvS0I92Gv2op5XW0RIBus5rRGUn3JpgEFCBAg2THlC3HYByHnqAYb2t3SAUkA-cS_uZw8E7bfHKLyqty6mJZmd-VtH_EzgLnM_zbN2xuvcpcH6jBc7wO19VVrZMVZ47FZL0onJ5e0mbqARnjyrJlkPyTjLlyjLlg6525xSbYvzzDDGGOoxCwSPZEH8k-K8i3wEAAP__hIdhWw) showing the median income in all 50 states.

Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1330278e194949d2987e6fccfe712a89&_e=D3wqGoJJrwa7vFyGcRa4gqawgSjn9hdY8j_6_T7-wmKIK2wOSrln8ehVXaRUtdGCCQ4lahsz4ohBGjo3ThQZD9vtJtuhgOXKePB4VB_5rSTbMWhzJqhIYag_RqQJk090SSQbCCelvO3jhN86_ZsN7BeNTad386XEQIDBa2xsoYGGlXFuOowEHOpwRS_n_g6KtIOds11L5_zFJjQUbiJsjmLATU4Qu_ZuT0pf7QSXQPwPJ3C_PFB_tN7ZhGrc7kh0y2hHZXv23pCrRAoNETVoy2je8p9b6goMTzTeAd492Z6q2od1XBuGht2CyQkNHeq-_Xf7O3mvAXXlrouDDmWWhCj31j5i0KhqfsuQMC6DduNS2146p6yJNhKbTdCdQcHlu7-19RXIxEMZ0er5woypo7FSnItiIHcUfM2W_SVxt8S7T8BTLz65HC8yznAV5VII)

| Friends, Here's the latest list of bills Governor Youngkin has acted on as of today, Friday, April 5 at midnight. The deadline for him to act is this coming Monday, April 8 at midnight.
Here is the most current list of bills Governor Youngkin has either signed into law, vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend.
Any of the 2,000 plus bills that the governor does not act on become law.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.

subject: A call to courage
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Comer for Congress**
body:
I am dead serious when I tell you that the Democrats in D.C. only care about one thing.

| | [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32786%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hFlhQpttHLp7%2bqp6TmFXGQ&sysid=1)
---
Friend, It’s clear that Democrats will choose their party over their country and the truth at every turn. **That’s why I am preparing criminal referrals of Biden Family members as a part of my Impeachment Inquiry.** **When President Trump returns to the White House, it’s critical the new leadership at the DOJ have everything they need to prosecute the Biden Crime Family and deliver swift justice.**
| [ **STAND WITH COMER** ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32787%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=l6slo0DGq8yXUGFk5OqZfA&sysid=1)
---
This is the best way to hold the Biden’s accountable for their crimes, as it’s now clear the Democrats will do anything to hold onto power. I am dead serious when I tell you that the Democrats in D.C. only care about one thing. They don’t care about the Constitution, the Rule of Law, or even their sacred oaths of office. They only care about POWER. And we must make sure that no matter what hijinks they try to pull before the election that they are removed from power in every branch of government. [**That’s why I am in dire need of your support.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32788%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6A%2fWo%2fZ7Z6aPKy7hPJoGsw&sysid=1) I’m on the frontlines here in D.C. fighting to uphold the constitution and rid our government of corruption, but as the old adage goes, no good deed goes unpunished. **It’s a damn shame that me and my family are being put through this just because I have the courage to speak truth to power.** There was a time not long ago when every American knew that having courage in the face of power was virtuous, and I still do. [**If you do too, then I’d be honored to have your support as I defend myself and my good name from the disgusting attacks I continue to face.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32789%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=x4tvCD8cRfc2I%2bOYsayQyg&sysid=1) I’d love nothing more than to go back to my farm in Kentucky and raise my family in peace, but this moment calls for men and women of courage and conviction to fight for our country. I believe with every fiber of my being that America is worth saving and I’m ready to fight with everything I have to save her. [**Friend, I’m calling on you to fight with me.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32780%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=et%2fHVGkOwbzmuduUORzdjQ&sysid=1)
_With Courage,_
James Comer Chairman, House Oversight Committee

Dear Peter,
Our founding fathers deemed freedom of speech so paramount that they placed it at the forefront of the Constitution, understanding that all other rights hinge upon it.
**A government that has the capacity to silence its opponents has the power to commit any kind of atrocity.**
We witnessed the alarming beginnings of such power abuse during the pandemic when our government initiated and actively engaged in the censorship of social media speech.
_This was a seismic shift in American governance._ Once the powers-that-be realized the public's complacency, and that there would be no media uproar, they brazenly violated other constitutional rights.
They shuttered countless businesses nationwide without due process or just compensation, a direct violation of the Fifth Amendment.
They trampled upon the remaining pillars of the First Amendment, curbing freedom of worship by closing down churches and synagogues across the country without scientific rationale or democratic procedure.
All the safeguards of the democratic process that I've spent four decades defending were discarded with impunity.
**The abuses of power from the highest levels of our government continues to this day.** [The repercussions are dire, and the urgency cannot be overstated. ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=preserving_4_5_24_nd1rs&n=5)

name: Chuck Morse
subject: Checking In: How Did Your Family Weather the Snowstorm?
body:
I hope you're doing okay after yesterday's storm...
| |
---
**Derek** **I wanted to check in and see how you're doing with yesterday's storm. Our family spent the day without power, navigating around fallen trees in our neighborhood—it was quite the adventure.** **One particularly large tree blocked the intersection at Fresh Water Farms on Route 111! Fortunately, I spotted the situation while salting our walkways. I was quickly able to hop in the tractor and clear the debris for the line of traffic - I've always said not every challenge requires government intervention!** **For me, leadership goes beyond titles or policies—it's about actively supporting our community and lending a hand to our neighbors. These are values instilled in me from a young age, and they remain guiding principles i n my life.** **Whether it's $5, $25, or $50, I need your support to ensure our next Governor prioritizes community, leadership, and service by chipping in to support our campaign. | | |

That's it, friend — _reproductive rights are effectively OVER in Florida._
**By upholding the already-unconstitutional 15-week abortion ban, our state Supreme Court has given Ron DeSantis'_even stricter_ six-week ban the green light to take effect next month.**
I grieve for the countless people across our state and our nation whose rights to bodily autonomy and comprehensive medical care — and in some cases, _whose lives themselves_ — have been stripped away. And as a mom to two young women, imagining the impacts this could have on all our futures makes me sick.
**But I won't let the pain stop me from fighting back. I can't. Especially not when the Florida Supreme Court ruled IN FAVOR of our ballot initiative to let voters decide the future of abortion rights this November.**
So I vow to resist with everything I've got: from taking on GOP extremist Rick Scott to leading the fight on the frontlines at home,**I won't stop until we regain the rights we never should've lost in the first place.**
**But the only way we win the fight is if you're standing strong with me.**
I still need just **272** more grassroots supporters to help me tell Florida's far-right leadership enough is enough — and friend, I'm counting on seeing your signature on my petition by the midnight deadline.

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T14677d2c-f8fe-4c2e-aa9a-1171782444d6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
| Hi Peter, I wanted you to hear the news from me: **I’m officially running for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 7th District.** When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together. “What has changed” they ask? Everything. Together, our A-Team has...
* Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.
* Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
* Advocated for justice for the people, from peacefully protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza.

**This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted inhumanity and love — but only if we keep fighting.** [**So Peter, I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $25 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Blue Amp Action. We rely on small-dollar donations to do this work, and your support will ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. Thank you.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5d0ab5c5-3be0-489a-bdbb-97cc60c89f52/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Six years ago, this team elected the first Black woman and first person of color to represent Massachusetts in Congress — but this movement is about so much more than that. I told this team that if you sent me to Washington, I wasn’t going alone. I was bringing all of you with me. You all are my teachers, my partners, and my accomplices. The issues that you care about are the issues I fight for. By investing in our campaign, you are affirming the dignity and worth of every person who has been left out and left behind. You are sending a message that corporate interests should never win over working people. You’re affirming that abortion is health care. That a college education should move us forward, not set us back. That Black men deserve to grow old. That you believe that all of our children deserve a future — whether they’re in Massachusetts, Gaza, or Haiti. That this movement is STRONG. I love the Massachusetts 7th district. [**It is an honor to represent the people of the Massachusetts 7th, and this movement, in Congress. If you can, please split a donation of $25 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Blue Amp Action during this important moment.** ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T70339982-12c2-4ed9-a1be-d9612a179ebc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Your Congresswoman, Ayanna

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country. — _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1310%2E135344%2E75OGrg)

This week, Donald Trump came to Grand Rapids, where he stood with his endorsed candidate, ex-Congressman Mike Rogers right behind him, and attacked Elissa, saying she “doesn’t represent what Michigan stands for.”
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-apr24.UpsRlZ&refcode=em240405-1-30&t=2&akid=1310%2E135344%2E75OGrg)
During his remarks, Trump advanced lies, called undocumented immigrants “animals,” and even said that if he loses this election, our country will “cease to exist.”
He also sent a strong message that he’s invested in Michigan’s Senate race. He knows that control of not just the Senate, but also the White House are at stake in this race.
So we’re working to send a message of our own: that Elissa stands with Michiganders, while Mike Rogers has always been in this for himself. If you’d like to help us send that message, please consider chipping in a few bucks to support the campaign today: **[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/Stand-With-Elissa](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-apr24.UpsRlZ&refcode=em240405-1-30&t=3&akid=1310%2E135344%2E75OGrg)**
Elissa is running for office because we need a new generation of leaders who remember it’s about service to country, not serving yourself. body:

Friend, **o ne year ago today, I launched my reelection campaign for Nevada’s Senate seat.**
Since then, Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate Sam Brown launched _his own_ campaign to defeat me, a shady MAGA billionaire poured $2 million into Nevada to flip my seat red, and I’ve officially become the most vulnerable woman in the Senate.
**A lot can change in a year, friend. But one thing that will never change is _why_ ****I’m running.** **[If you know my “why” already, will you chip in $5 or more now to become a Founding Donor of my campaign to keep Nevada and the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82397036/465246167/2034486384?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3661-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNWJhNmYxYS00ZGYzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OH4NuR3K0dnokTQnGRh4jdBUGF3BWQjOYe-Xx50oqwQ=)**

In my pursuit as a candidate for US Congress in Texas's 8th district, I've made connecting with people a cornerstone of my mission... | | | | | [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=01deea32b1&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
# Embracing Faith and Fostering Unity

**Peter -**
Reflecting on the significance of engaging where communities gather, particularly in places of faith, and the warm welcome I've received, I wanted to share this personal insight. [**But before delving deeper, I'm reaching out to ask for your support by considering a donation to our campaign today. Your contribution could truly make a profound impact on our efforts for Texas's 8th district.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=28c23c3385&e=a2a46ff12c)
In my pursuit as a candidate for US Congress in Texas's 8th district, I've made connecting with people a cornerstone of my mission. One significant place where communities converge is within places of worship. Engaging in worship services has provided me a connection to the community.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=d43c68ca6c&e=a2a46ff12c)

However, growing up in a deeply sheltered and religious environment, I navigated my own path, ultimately encountering challenges in adulthood. Revisiting church posed initial hurdles, but as a political candidate, I recognized the importance of engaging where people gather.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=5ef023c3e9&e=a2a46ff12c)
Venturing into various places of worship, I've been warmly received despite some differing political perspectives. This experience reshaped my view of the purpose of church, reinforcing my belief in the unifying strength of shared goals and unity.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=a0d54926db&e=a2a46ff12c)
Despite our diverse backgrounds, our common love for the community unites us in our joint efforts to aid those in need.
I am grateful for the life I lead, my wonderful neighbors, and the community I am honored to serve. Your warm welcome inspires me to remain engaged and present in every community. Let’s keep working towards a better district here in TX-8. Thank you for your ongoing support.

[**The people of District 8 and communities throughout it are deserving of compassionate, fair representation. I am ready to be a part of that representation. If you can stand by me in this and chip in today, I would appreciate it so mu**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=1cb3ea77a4&e=a2a46ff12c)**ch.**
| [Support This Campaign!](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=10c99ff6eb&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
Thank you for listening and learning a little more about me and why this means so much.

\- Laura

Fellow Conservative,

We thought the government was pressuring Big Tech to censor stories about Hunter Biden’s foreign business dealings and his laptop days before the 2020 presidential election...**then brave journalists exposed the Twitter Files.**

We thought that it was likely that COVID came from a lab. Then FBI Director Christopher Wray confirmed this spring that coronavirus likely stemmed from a lab leak in Wuhan.

We thought the Steele Dossier was fake. Then we found out the **Democrats knew the dossier was false but used it to spy on President Trump’s campaign in 2016.**

**_With every new bit of infomation we find that the truth is always worse than we thought._

ALWAYS.**

Whether it is the CDC or the DOJ, the FBI and social media companies taking down posts and limiting speech, **federal agencies are targeting the American people who they are supposed to serve**. And the Democrats? **They always seem to turn a blind eye and move on.

This sponsored message from Defend The Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8808db3dc0174e81a2a05be531f0e93e&_e=CkA5aqBfvq9lWewlvnsgsRus5M0BoxpfP3s-6PsgeOGd-7AuxJKrhoWjNYlgJO9sVozdQlgAaHp3_Bd8ganOM0U3qR9LyT2C-dYE2OYFRMBetir2_toaTlEZw1mHEvD-nZCQ9Lb2I6CObiqv5rIgyco8-M-l-eQSR1lwygu-QKN7XMybHcDivCUjxQBgsonUBAihe8aJpR5hC6Vgsp6Zz5i0ySTw-iw5rbpXGMpjPfUPeTssyzXQVV2JFh224Dkf621JO7qR2ePptfuJ8LxR648lWmycpWLgce9NIQj7F0dbnNTrYNZhxrx2CaOPcjf8BkyAyMs3aPJsHSRAP8pn6HR5v3b57HPF9s_cehL-1BKqpOaxuOvXbvNQTi2xQYpystunDJDJxXOrj7WB0yubDAhVBH_ZOKfI3LQcUOR4KCA%3D) That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8808db3dc0174e81a2a05be531f0e93e&_e=CkA5aqBfvq9lWewlvnsgsRus5M0BoxpfP3s-6PsgeOGd-7AuxJKrhoWjNYlgJO9sVozdQlgAaHp3_Bd8ganOM0U3qR9LyT2C-dYE2OYFRMBetir2_toaTlEZw1mHEvD-nZCQ9Lb2I6CObiqv5rIgyco8-M-l-eQSR1lwygu-QKN7XMybHcDivCUjxQBgsonUBAihe8aJpR5hC6Vgsp6Zz5i0ySTw-iw5rbpXGMpjPfUPeTssyzXQVV2JFh224Dkf621JO7qR2ePptfuJ8LxR636GPcpfIgLYd7TGWSHj7Xci2ysagArY6m9Rh_mY7x6bE62vxITTZx73GNQZe2FbX1xMuwANfXqCbg-O7hxdnmFJ-n4qMeyG2OsPzNFOMVAfcyfHnY50NIH5qOhwDNlMLoG_J11qJ_5TRfV91wDcJec%3D)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. I’m proud to be the daughter of hardworking immigrants here in Colorado and the first Latina with the honor of representing our state in Congress. From my days as a pediatrician in Adams County to serving our community in public office, I’ve always been guided by the principles my parents instilled in me: family, community, and hard work.
It’s no secret that under the current far-right leadership, the House of Representatives is defined more by extremism and dysfunction than anything else. But I’ve still fought tirelessly to make health care more affordable, reduce the cost of living for working families, and defend every American’s right to choose — and I’m proud of the progress we’ve made together so far.
**Peter, all of that progress is now on the line. And if we fall short, my community’s “voice” in Congress will be just another anti-abortion extremist backed by Speaker Mike Johnson and the Koch Brothers’ super PAC.**
Make no mistake, we’ve got a tough fight ahead of us, but it’s a fight we’re ready for.

I'm counting on your support to overcome the hurdles ahead and ensure we can continue making a meaningful difference in the lives of Colorado families and beyond.

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ad6e0b5f233d40d3b5e0082479cd853e&_e=3HTbm64huSSg4ZQa2lxHcMYMrvQMz7zk0fk6_MaVz7tz48KSY4UfjFuJqKi5K5h-3kUe1pFDlVS7RBMa1KTI71qHWARwFzUnpEyXh4ZiLNqE0gHq68_pzpVXWwo3jdeiRzeqYKyIqBZjEHeCo66HPrU022_k_jr7JkjbzZG8BdA_dcaFkGUSICuIYTbY-eQd43aM7L9ATtBEjXeTVSk5Ky7JnIi_A1_4k8tEkoe6XcYLzxzO49D3cVhQ0iHioPxljxB8mt2wFCV3kga98pajrPb22p-iHZQ5w9Kw2x-u3BD4aGzVnlC3J5V2v5zbZueNHOjufIn9BEnc1PuWuWSyBJgec5Xen4-uLuXskLzrWN29zxAL7HLqqTxOXGIa9TiqhlTeoh3wDblDFkr1ZaIeGA%3D%3D) **
As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ad6e0b5f233d40d3b5e0082479cd853e&_e=3HTbm64huSSg4ZQa2lxHcMYMrvQMz7zk0fk6_MaVz7tz48KSY4UfjFuJqKi5K5h-3kUe1pFDlVS7RBMa1KTI71qHWARwFzUnpEyXh4ZiLNqE0gHq68_pzpVXWwo3jdeiRzeqYKyIqBZjEHeCo66HPrU022_k_jr7JkjbzZG8BdA_dcaFkGUSICuIYTbY-eQd43aM7L9ATtBEjXeTVSk5Ky7JnIi_A1_4k8tEkoe6XcYLzxzO49D3cVhQ0iHioPxlKfu_uWuVO5tGY9O2aQU-BxpbQVBAWw21pcc5MoYweNAK4PuLZrIDcLlnv8rxqV7B53mAv7D553KcH7UAoAWrDDpLEHwiuSp5euT6Wtmh_gNsVzO0Nuaed038cMyv-J7cA25XEk0WGzR1h1yMTgb-Cg%3D%3D)

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=ad6e0b5f233d40d3b5e0082479cd853e&_e=3HTbm64huSSg4ZQa2lxHcMYMrvQMz7zk0fk6_MaVz7tz48KSY4UfjFuJqKi5K5h-3kUe1pFDlVS7RBMa1KTI71qHWARwFzUnpEyXh4ZiLNqE0gHq68_pzpVXWwo3jdeiRzeqYKyIqBZjEHeCo66HPrU022_k_jr7JkjbzZG8BdA_dcaFkGUSICuIYTbY-eQd43aM7L9ATtBEjXeTVSk5Ky7JnIi_A1_4k8tEkoe6XcYLzxzO49D3cVhQ0iHioPxlaoLmNijfCl-8NdoSvnASEm7boRek1kD_QY9GE7aOzbCSCYkXSJFagKLcffSQjLt4SQbAwRk2bchryK3Aicyqe85cZ6z3R7RtC4NIedP2oJjX2MQtRjsxdTAQzlGitD17AveA3wPhUxubmEmETXpMMA%3D%3D)

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

body:
With our movement under attack from the right wing and their billionaire-funded super PACs, we need to send a powerful message about the grassroots strength of this campaign. That is something we can ONLY do together.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1068%2E791427%2EvNQ2PV)

Hey team, it's Ilhan. I'm writing to ask you to **[add your name to say you personally endorse my campaign for Congress in Minnesota's 5th district.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-april24-personal-endorse/?source=em240405-1-t2&refcode2=1068.791427.vNQ2PV&akid=1068%2E791427%2EvNQ2PV) But before I explain why your support today is so important to our movement, let me start at the very beginning.
Now, one thing you may know about my story is that I am a refugee.
When I was just a young child, my family was forced to escape civil war in Somalia and take sanctuary in a Kenyan refugee camp for four years.
We didn't always have food, or running water. But we did have a dream that one day, we would be able to get out of that camp and start a new life in the United States.
At the time, I couldn't have imagined that someday, I would run for office in a new country, nevermind become the first African-born member of Congress, or that tens of thousands of people would stand with me along the way.
When I got to Washington, my colleagues and the political establishment told me that I was destined to fail. They said a Somali, Muslim, hijab-wearing, Black progressive woman couldn’t enact change in an institution with rules not created for us.
They said that I would fail, and that two years later we'd run again and lose.
But we did not back down. We fought hard for our ideas. We forced climate action to the top of the agenda. We empowered Medicare to finally negotiate prescription drug prices. We made justice in all its forms a priority.
Then we ran again, and won. And once more after that, for good measure.
But the truth is, we still have a great deal of work ahead of us. The insiders and special interests who never wanted me in Congress are going to come back with more money and resources than ever before to try to take me down here in 2024.
**I know that I cannot fight back against them alone. That is something that is going to require ALL of us.**
**[So I'm asking you to stand with me today. Will you add your name to personally endorse our re-election campaign? Building this movement is something we must all do together.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-april24-personal-endorse/?source=em240405-1-t2&refcode2=1068.791427.vNQ2PV&akid=1068%2E791427%2EvNQ2PV)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-april24-personal-endorse/?source=em240405-1-t2&refcode2=1068.791427.vNQ2PV&akid=1068%2E791427%2EvNQ2PV)**
When I was first elected to Congress in 2018, our ideas were called radical:
🏥 Medicare for All
🌅 A Green New Deal
📈 Raising the Minimum Wage
🎓 Canceling Student Debt
❌ Banning Assault Weapons

body:
Friend, I've got some great news for you: The Florida Supreme Court just ruled to keep abortion rights on the ballot this November!
But we can’t celebrate just yet — the court also UPHELD Ron DeSantis' unconstitutional 15-week abortion ban, which means his even more extreme six-week ban will take effect in 30 days.
Now, we finally have the chance to overturn Ron DeSantis' extreme ban and restore our reproductive freedom at the polls.
The tides are changing in Florida. And this ballot initiative has a very good chance of passing. Recent polling shows that 62% of voters, including a majority of Republicans, support passing it. And a massive 75% of voters oppose the extreme six-week ban that could take effect in a matter of weeks.
This is what a powerful grassroots movement can accomplish. And that's exactly what we need to defeat Rick Scott and stop him from passing a nationwide ban on abortions.
Listen, Rick Scott wants you to believe that our home is a red state. But that couldn't be further from the truth. More and more of us are rejecting his far-right agenda every day. And polling data shows that this race is neck and neck.
But now, he’s spending millions to lie about his record and launch baseless attacks against me — and I can’t overcome his self-funded ads without the crucial resources to fight back. So please, will you please chip in $15 or more — split between my campaign and Serve America — before 11:59 p.m. tonight to help me reach my rapid- response goal? With all eyes on Florida, we can’t stumble now. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Together, we will win a better future for our state and our families.
Thank you for all that you do,
Debbie

Ted has repeatedly gone to bat for gun owners - and he's literally been at the forefront of the battle to protect our right to keep and bear arms.

His relentless advocacy was **pivotal** in the historic [**_District of Columbia v. Heller_**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5c1ef5833e8b4c0b93c0991853bf23cb&_e=HFGO06sx3qY6P37zQE8T6YCSPxfo1e3n0CHX8drg5sqhdZBPJyCVIzShP6HVO6QACgjdDxEZfjkWM5nhGqyL6nLPYUNXShecbgecj27Q2e4Q9TcRxUlKQFUzPQWJJy-6R32Ugz6Uo1FFzuy_NgiwNvhrgrSDsRUE9prCEY_BdPgB21c6WC_RNihJ2gWurl2_jWF7aiNdjMPzDmXUF22Vx74wShhI4ThOE7W0aEQUTVU5OCkf9BQu2KfpfSh-VmCVUlRw5dUHp-z9wNt71gw9j8EsWxg6U21AUnMC21dkkxIr7b4PAzIrGcwp4_WHFPCrwdMS6Q6huxMVPgXXRQUPpIY0SM68PAt6eJw9XItTX2nUp38W2_Fm0SnD449g8nILdTO6pguw47gHpUdr9p2tz-oUPV0dldrRDKBN_xaZ_EN9ARCETUH9BzKeq7vZQRf98A8GafTFYAsR94BaZwIoeg%3D%3D) decision, where he fought alongside 31 states and argued on their behalf to overturn a ban on firearms. The United States Supreme Court agreed with his arguments, delivering a landmark victory that affirmed our right to possess a firearm inside our homes for self-protection.
---
[**KEEP TED CRUZ IN THE SENATE**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5c1ef5833e8b4c0b93c0991853bf23cb&_e=HFGO06sx3qY6P37zQE8T6YCSPxfo1e3n0CHX8drg5sqhdZBPJyCVIzShP6HVO6QACgjdDxEZfjkWM5nhGqyL6nLPYUNXShecbgecj27Q2e4Q9TcRxUlKQFUzPQWJJy-6R32Ugz6Uo1FFzuy_NgiwNvhrgrSDsRUE9prCEY_BdPgB21c6WC_RNihJ2gWurl2_jWF7aiNdjMPzDmXUF22Vx74wShhI4ThOE7W0aEQUTVU5OCkf9BQu2KfpfSh-VmCVUlRw5dUHp-z9wNt71gw9j8EsWxg6U21AUnMC21dkkxK9En4RaPdBQnko5AZaEmmBhUi1U93NrXCP899dd8SMSJd-SvbnL4xCQcAhhigkAhLxpx6ROoH58e9ueoN7l7m0Z6QPyFY5OMuqkk-A2XmjlYfzhWM-Yt8K3I7ULdPGkf6eqeHd0BLbf1uvao-UQIZa1-s88CgZ22FkQCdYc2VIfA%3D%3D)

name: Juliana at United We Dream Action
subject: This is what we’d lose if we lost DACA:
body:
The 2023 DACA survey results are out. Here’s how the program has changed lives for the better: | | | Peter, We just published some findings from our latest survey of DACA recipients, and the results speak for themselves. Of the DACA recipients surveyed:
* **94%** are currently employed
* Recipients’ average hourly wage more than doubled from **$11.92** to **$31.52** per hour — an increase of 164.4 percent — after receiving DACA.
* **30.7%** of survey respondents purchased their first homes in 2023 — a huge increase from 2022.
* **65%** of respondents currently in school said that because of DACA, **“[they] pursued educational opportunities that [they] previously could not.”**
* **Over 60%** of respondents bought their first car after receiving DACA

The DACA program has allowed hundreds of thousands of immigrant youth to work and attend school without the threat of deportation — and the benefits have been immeasurable. But currently, DACA is hanging by a thread with new attacks coming every day. **DACA was always meant to be a temporary band-aid fix, but with so much on the line, now is the time for Congress and President Biden to deliver a permanent solution.** If DACA is shut down, **over 40%** of survey respondents would be less likely to report wage theft or look for a new job, **63%** would be less likely to continue their education, and many would be less likely to attend public gatherings, report crimes, open a bank account, and more. Losing DACA would be catastrophic for hundreds of millions of immigrants. **So now we’re calling on Congress and President Biden to act NOW to deliver a path to citizenship for all 11 million undocumented folks. Here’s how the program has changed lives for the better: | | | Peter, We just published some findings from our latest survey of DACA recipients, and the results speak for themselves. Of the DACA recipients surveyed: 94% are currently employed Recipients’ average hourly wage more than doubled from $11.92 to $31.52 per hour — an increase of 164.4 percent — after receiving DACA. 30.7% of survey respondents purchased their first homes in 2023 — a huge increase from 2022. 65% of respondents currently in school said that because of DACA, “[they] pursued educational opportunities that [they] previously could not.” Over 60% of respondents bought their first car after receiving DACA The DACA program has allowed hundreds of thousands of immigrant youth to work and attend school without the threat of deportation — and the benefits have been immeasurable. But currently, DACA is hanging by a thread with new attacks coming every day. DACA was always meant to be a temporary band-aid fix, but with so much on the line, now is the time for Congress and President Biden to deliver a permanent solution. If DACA is shut down, over 40% of survey respondents would be less likely to report wage theft or look for a new job, 63% would be less likely to continue their education, and many would be less likely to attend public gatherings, report crimes, open a bank account, and more. Losing DACA would be catastrophic for hundreds of millions of immigrants. So now we’re calling on Congress and President Biden to act NOW to deliver a path to citizenship for all 11 million undocumented folks. soon the darkness will pass...and our long-awaited King of kings

Sincerely,
Dr.

Senior

[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=bc07c0309b&e=00028e5542)
[**‘Reporting for duty, Mr. President!’ James Judge announces jump to Florida’s 15th Congressional District, after claiming victory in FL-12**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=52bf4a0a96&e=00028e5542)
_The firebrand conservative announced that he will challenge struggling Congresswoman, Rep. Laurel Lee (R-FL), who has a failing grade as a conservative in Congress. Just last month, former President Donald Trump criticized Lee and called for a true conservative replacement to step forward._
TAMPA, Fla. – James Judge (R-FL), the Tampa Bay area native, America-first conservative, Iraq war-veteran and Tampa small business owner who lives in Pasco County, announced his move into the Republican primary for Florida’s 15th Congressional District on Friday, claiming a victory in FL-12.
“In just six months, by shining a magnifying glass on my last opponent and holding him accountable, I was able to transform him from a D-rated Republican, a Congressman who voted about 60 percent of the time in-line with the Constitution, to a nearly A-rated conservative, who now aligns with the House Freedom Caucus,” said Judge. “I’m asking voters to imagine what I could do with a full 2-year term in Washington, where I pledge to hold the rest of Congress accountable.”
Judge was so effective at holding Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL) accountable to conservative principles that President Donald J. Trump recently endorsed Bilirakis for reelection.
By making the jump, Judge is answering President Trump’s call for a true conservative to step forward and take on Rep. Laurel Lee (R-FL), the embattled incumbent Congresswoman for Florida’s 15th Congressional District.
According to Judge, Lee’s record is shockingly terrible and even worse than that of Bilirakis, but says the remedy lies with electing God-fearing conservatives like himself. “I believe fixing Congress isn’t as difficult as people make it out to be. We just need to elect officials who realize they will stand before God one day and give an account for their actions and inactions,” Judge said. “It’s important to note my focus remains the same. I am running to end the anarchy at the southern border, restore law-and-order nationwide, balance the budget and pay down our national debt, something the Congresswoman has demonstrated she is adamantly against.”
In March, Lee opposed members of the House Freedom Caucus and voted in favor of the new $1.2 trillion funding package, which included more federal spending for LGBT initiatives and diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) programs.
According to Judge, Lee, who is still in her first term, has consistently failed to uphold conservative values and adhere to the Constitution. According to conservative watchdog groups like The Freedom Index (50 percent) and the Republican Liberty Caucus (55 percent), Lee has a 52.5 percent average, when it comes to upholding the Constitution.
“When your job is to support and defend the Constitution, these aren’t just failing grades, I’d say she is virtually working as a Democrat,” said Judge. “Equally disturbing are the special interest groups who are funding her campaign.”
According to a recent review of political contributions tracked by the Federal Election Commission, Lee has accepted hundreds of special interest contributions in her short stint, including funding from Meta, Facebook’s parent company, and Google, both of which helped rig the 2020 election against President Trump and have consistently demonstrated their opposition to conservative, family values.
“I look forward to giving to constituents of Florida’s 15th Congressional District a truly conservative option this primary election and I pledge to wage an all out war against the radical progressives when I get to Washington,” Judge said.
**About James Judge:** James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a ranch in Pasco county, with their five dogs, three cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.
_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _🚨 Voter Registration Deadline ⏳_**
---
Friends, We want to remind you that _**MONDAY APRIL 8, 2024 IS THE FINAL DATE TO REGISTER ONLINE TO VOTE IN THE UPCOMING 2024 PRIMARY ELECTIONS**_ , and your participation is of the utmost importance. There are vital races up and down the ticket, including picking our party's next nominee to be our state's next Governor. With the 2024 election cycle being so critical, we cannot afford for a single Republican to sit this one out. The last three years have been challenging for all of us. While Indiana has managed to stay afloat due to strong Republican leadership in every facet of our state government, the rest of the country has not been so lucky. This is a pivotal year in our country's history. It is time we right the ship and _**GET REPUBLICANS BACK IN THE DRIVER'S SEAT.**_ That starts with registering for the primary election, then getting out to vote! If you are already registered, you can encourage your friends and family to register too! We need every possible Republican, and we want everyone's voice to be heard! Remember, these few days are your last chance to register to vote in May. **In order to register or update voter registration, visit[indianavoters.in.gov](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4dea10653b21c9833947229f28c3afba/ebe39dc2ae82c00ac3d6b838967d376c/40313). Or for more information, visit the Secretary of State's website [HERE](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/4dea10653b21c9833947229f28c3afba/67e4396106138366c3d6b838967d376c/40313). ** _**IF YOUR COUNTY CLERK'S OFFICE IS CLOSED ON MONDAY APRIL 8 DUE TO THE ECLIPSE, YOU CAN REGISTER IN PERSON ON TUESDAY APRIL 9, BUT YOU SHOULD CHECK WITH YOUR COUNTY CLERK'S OFFICE. ALL ONLINE REGISTRATION CLOSES ON MONDAY APRIL 8.**_ Thank you for your dedication to the Republican Party and for taking the time to make sure your voices are heard. Thank you for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

| | Last month, a group of House Republicans called the "Republican Study Committee" released a budget proposal with some utterly extreme ideas. How extreme? Here are some of the worst:
* Raising the retirement age
* Cutting Social Security
* Passing a national abortion ban
* Gutting Medicaid and the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP)

I've always believed that when someone states their policy goals, we should take them at their word. **And this is no exception to that. That's why I'm doubling down to make sure that**** _nothing_****in this budget proposal ever becomes law.** As long as I'm representing the people of Oregon in the U.S. Senate, I can guarantee you that I will fight with everything I've got to make sure any bill that restricts reproductive rights, harms health care programs, or threatens Americans' earned retirement benefits is **not going to become law.** But our Senate majority is on the line in 2024. In 2020, we were barely able to win out with a razor-thin majority. It's never been more important that we defend and expand Democratic control of the Senate. The map is tough, and if Republicans gain just**two seats,** they'll remove one of the last bulwarks against the extremism coming out of the House. So I need your help to fight hard on behalf of Democrats in competitive races this year — from Wisconsin to Nevada to Montana to Ohio to Pennsylvania to Arizona. This seat had never been held by a woman until 2016, and in the midst of devastating attacks on our autonomy and reproductive freedoms, having a woman continue to represent Delaware in the U.S. House is more critical than ever.

My career has been defined by my commitment to fighting for the rights of women, children, families, the LGBTQ+ community, and marginalized groups in my home state of Delaware _and_ across the country. In my four years as a state senator, I passed paid a family and medical leave bill, secured new gun safety laws, outlawed the outrageous "LGBTQ+ panic defense" in our state, and fought to bring down the cost of child care.

I made history as the first openly transgender state senator in the country — and if elected, I'll be the first openly transgender member of Congress.

**But not only am I running to make history, I'm running to make a difference.** We're living in a time when trans and reproductive rights have been disproportionately subject to hateful legislation, and I'm committed to ensuring that _everyone_ has the right to bodily autonomy and the right to determine the course of their futures, their families, and their lives.

**Because everyone deserves a member of Congress who sees and respects them.**
