| | Last month, the U.S. Supreme Court heard oral arguments in _Food and Drug Administration v. Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine_ — a case that threatens our ability to make medical decisions with our doctors about our own bodies. **The arguments presented only reaffirmed what we already knew: this case was built on deceitful claims about science and is a blatant assault on our reproductive freedom.** I am alarmed by the willingness of plaintiffs to disregard both scientific evidence and the expertise of the FDA in pursuit of a political agenda aimed at restricting access to abortion.**Despite clear statements from government officials affirming the safety and efficacy of mifepristone, anti-abortion groups have pushed this case to an unprecedented level.** Even more conservative justices have begun to recognize the extreme lengths these groups are willing to go to undermine our rights. It is essential to understand that the implications of this case extend beyond just abortion access. The very existence of this legal challenge threatens the availability of FDA-approved medications for political reasons. **This is not just about abortion; it is about safeguarding our entire health care system from political interference.** **Extremist groups have recognized that they cannot sway public opinion in their favor, so they are resorting to the courts to undermine democratic institutions. But we will not allow them to succeed.** In the coming months, the Supreme Court will face more challenges to reproductive rights, including cases on hospitals' ability to provide abortion care and minors' access to confidential contraception. In the face of these threats, it is crucial that we remain united and vocal in our support for reproductive freedom. **We must continue to advocate for evidence-based policies that protect our rights name: Hill Harper
subject: Beating thyroid cancer changed everything for me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
And is one of the reasons why I’m fighting for universal healthcare.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1136%2E62735%2E8_aTDL)
Hey, Peter —
**I wanted to take a moment to share a deeply personal story with you —** one that has shaped not only my own perspective but also my commitment to fighting for transformative change for our country’s healthcare system. It’s a longer email, so I hope you’ll take the time to read it.
Back in 2010, while filming in Atlanta, I woke up one morning unable to swallow. A sore throat had escalated into something far more serious, leading me to seek medical attention.
Little did I know that this visit would change the course of my life.
**After an immediate biopsy and a tense wait for results, I received news that I had cancer — the same disease that had taken the lives of my father, grandfather, and uncle.** It was a sobering moment for me, one that forced me to confront my mortality and the fragility of my own life.
But I refused to let fear consume me. With the support of my loved ones and the guidance of skilled medical professionals, I underwent surgery to remove my thyroid gland and embarked on a journey toward recovery. **Today, I am grateful to say that I am cancer-free and blessed with a clean bill of health.**
My own brush with cancer opened my eyes to the harsh realities faced by too many Americans. I've seen firsthand the devastating toll that sky-high medical costs can take on individuals and their loved ones. I've witnessed the crippling burden of medical debt, which can shatter dreams of the future and push families to the brink of financial ruin. And while I was fortunate to receive financial assistance from my union, I know that not everyone is so lucky.
**That's why I pledge to fight like hell for universal healthcare access for ALL Americans, regardless of the circumstances.** No one should have to endure the stress of choosing between their health and financial stability. No one should fear for their family’s future while they should be focusing on treatment and recovery. And no one, in the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, should go bankrupt just for seeking the lifesaving care they need.
**[So today, I’m humbly asking for your support. Will you please chip in any amount — even $5 or $10 — to help us win this critical Senate race, take our voices to the halls of power, and make universal healthcare a reality in America?](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1130?t=2&akid=1136%2E62735%2E8_aTDL)**
**[DONATE](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1130?t=3&akid=1136%2E62735%2E8_aTDL)**
Together, we can build a healthier, more equitable Michigan — and a stronger, more compassionate nation.
Thank you for your support,
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

Today, I ask you to join us in this solemn commitment by contributing to my campaign. Your donation will help us champion policies and initiatives that provide meaningful support to Gold Star families.

**** Peter,

Today I’m reaching out because, thanks to those of you who have donated, we were able to surpass our Pre-Primary FEC deadline goal. It was a busy time with both the end-of-quarter and pre-primary deadline back-to-back, but so many of you rose to the challenge.

_You all have shown me and this team so much support, and I’m beyond grateful to have you by my side. The NRCC, national Republicans, and my opponents might think there are inroads in the Philadelphia suburbs, but they don’t know how powerful this team is._

This November, I expect that we’ll see tight margins in races up and down the ballot, especially here in Pennsylvania – the center of the political universe. Here in PA-04, my team and I are doing all we can to win big in the Philadelphia suburbs. If you haven’t yet had the chance to donate and you’d like to support our work, **[you can do so here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82438889/465342087/-1186622517?amount=25&refcode=04052024_md_eoqty_en_1&refcode2=52946552-76f3-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Mjk0NjU1Mi03NmYzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rnW5_1j_jUW3IEvB0RAXUFcB5wDvhLBa9mjKt9df3QY=)**

With my sincere thanks,

Madeleine [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82438896/465342094/-1186622517?amount=25&refcode=04052024_md_eoqty_en_1&refcode2=52946552-76f3-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Mjk0NjU1Mi03NmYzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rnW5_1j_jUW3IEvB0RAXUFcB5wDvhLBa9mjKt9df3QY=)
* * *
_Madeleine is an attorney, professor, mother, grandmother, and Member of Congress, representing Pennsylvania’s 4th Congressional District of Berks and Montgomery Counties. name: Team McBride
subject: Some unfortunate truths
body:
Thanks for your support!
#
Let’s talk about fundraising —
**There are some unfortunate truths about running for office:**
1. Every candidate must ask people for money to fund their campaign’s efforts. Or a lot of mega-rich candidates who run pour oodles of their own money to essentially buy an election.

2. There’s a delicate balance between spending money and saving money — a campaign needs to invest wisely in having the capacity needed to win while ensuring they have the budget to reach voters in the final weeks of an election.

3. Fundraising fluctuates no matter how much energy your team puts into it because peoples’ interest in elections and campaigns shifts. Most people are thinking about visiting their family, shuffling kids to soccer and ballet practice, or even what’s for dinner tonight — not an election months away.

**The best thing we can do to combat fundraising challenges is simple: asking supporters (like you!) to chip in small amounts every month.**
Our campaign is very lucky that each and every month, more than 200 people make a small contribution to Sarah’s campaign.
And last month, 22% of our donations came in from monthly, recurring donors.
In April, we need to grow our monthly donors by 50% to make crucial investments in key staff and organizing events.
**We’ve noticed you haven’t made a contribution to Sarah’s campaign yet.[Could you commit to making a small, monthly donation?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240405-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240405-1-13&refcode2=13_21716_ZG8Eem&akid=13%2E21716%2EZG8Eem)**
Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue.

Thanks, as always, for your support of our campaign.
\- Team McBride

clean_body: Thanks for your support! Let’s talk about fundraising — There are some unfortunate truths about running for office: 1. Every candidate must ask people for money to fund their campaign’s efforts. Or a lot of mega-rich candidates who run pour oodles of their own money to essentially buy an election. 2. There’s a delicate balance between spending money and saving money — a campaign needs to invest wisely in having the capacity needed to win while ensuring they have the budget to reach voters in the final weeks of an election. 3. Fundraising fluctuates no matter how much energy your team puts into it because peoples’ interest in elections and campaigns shifts. Most people are thinking about visiting their family, shuffling kids to soccer and ballet practice, or even what’s for dinner tonight — not an election months away. The best thing we can do to combat fundraising challenges is simple: asking supporters (like you!) to chip in small amounts every month. Our campaign is very lucky that each and every month, more than 200 people make a small contribution to Sarah’s campaign. And last month, 22% of our donations came in from monthly, recurring donors. In April, we need to grow our monthly donors by 50% to make crucial investments in key staff and organizing events. We’ve noticed you haven’t made a contribution to Sarah’s campaign yet. Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue. Thanks, as always, for your support of our campaign. \- Team McBride

---
| | | Almost immediately after the disastrous bridge collapse in Baltimore, House Republicans sprang into action -- to prove they could be the biggest jerks in Washington. Before President Biden even requested emergency funding, maniacs in the House Freedom Caucus let it be known that it would have to include a completely unrelated provision regarding liquefied natural gas exports -- something likely to delay or kill the measure. **Emergency funding is there for emergencies, and there has historically been bipartisan agreement to get it to where it is needed as soon as possible**. But for the last several years, Republicans have been shamelessly blocking it for emergencies in Democratic states -- such as Maryland. [**Don't let them get away with it.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T494bd6f4-0860-4456-81a9-c85a33e30033/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) There is strong public support for emergency funding, and the more we can shine a light on what these jerks are doing, the greater the pressure will be for them to stand down. body:
We got word yesterday that Kari Lake took in $1 million at a fundraiser at Trump’s house in Palm Beach, Mar-a-Lago.
#

Peter, we got some bad news yesterday. It was tough to hear, but we owe it to you to explain what happened.
So, look: Every month we start off with a projection of what we need to raise to stay on track to our overall goals.
Everything we do plays a part in those projections: emails, texts, ads, donations on our website, phone calls, fundraisers, you name it. They all add up towards our goal — what we need to raise to win. It’s not arbitrary or random, it’s a specific amount.
We’ve had a historic campaign so far, and that’s thanks to the support you’ve given.
But here’s the tough part: We got word yesterday that Kari Lake took in $1 million at a fundraiser at Trump’s house in Palm Beach, Mar-a-Lago, and that Trump himself attacked Ruben at that fundraiser.
$1 million in one night is an absolutely staggering amount, and with Trump tearing into Ruben we know the MAGA-right is going to join him. Even on our best days we don’t come close to raising that much.
So today, we’re coming to you. If Kari Lake keeps up that kind of fundraising we are in serious trouble. We need an absolutely huge day of fundraising to try and keep pace.

[**That's why I'm going to ask you to donate $14 as we come up on 14 weeks into 2024**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82443386/465347658/-2022193277?&amounts=10,15,25,50,100,500&amount=14&refcode=jtk1373-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGQ5NzQ0Mi03OGYzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dnJ36pgEdpvm6WvPq3w4TxJVF8Lzs5LN1WArIHVbt6M=) – but first I wanted to explain why your investment in my work is so important.

subject: I want you to hear this from me, Peter

body:
It is an honor to be in this fight with you. | | | Hi Peter, I wanted you to hear the news from me: **I’m officially running for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 7th District.** When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together. “What has changed” they ask? Everything. Together, our A-Team has worked with allies like the Working Families Party to keep up the fight for working people in Massachusetts and across the country. We’ve:
* Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.
* Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
* Advocated for justice for the people, from protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza.

**This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted in humanity and love — but only if we keep fighting.** **[So Peter, I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $10 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and the Working Families Party. Campaigns like ours rely on small-dollar donations, and your support will ensure that we can keep fighting for progressive policies together. clean_body: It is an honor to be in this fight with you. | | | Hi Peter, I wanted you to hear the news from me: I’m officially running for re-election to represent Massachusetts’ 7th District. When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change. That a Democrat is a Democrat. That I had nothing to offer and that our movement was fleeting. But starting with Election Night in 2018, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we have made history together. “What has changed” they ask? Everything. Together, our A-Team has worked with allies like the Working Families Party to keep up the fight for working people in Massachusetts and across the country. We’ve: Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers. Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated. Advocated for justice for the people, from protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza. This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted in humanity and love — but only if we keep fighting. By investing in our campaign, you are affirming the dignity and worth of every person who has been left out and left behind. You are sending a message that corporate interests should never win over working people. You’re affirming that abortion is health care. That a college education should move us forward, not set us back. That Black men deserve to grow old. That you believe that all of our children deserve a future — whether they’re in Massachusetts, Gaza, or Haiti. That this movement is STRONG. In solidarity, Ayanna Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. As a supporter of Powered by People’s voter registration efforts, we want
to make sure you know how we allocate the donations we receive.

Thanks to the generous contributions of our grassroots donors, we’ve been
able to fund:

* The events we hold to recruit and train Volunteer Deputy Registrars
(VDRs)
* The technology we use for text banks, phone banks, and relational
organizing
* Stamps and envelopes to mail voter registration forms to unregistered
Texans
* Clipboards and pens for our volunteers registering voters out in the
field
* Salaries for a small handful of staff who keep our thousands of
volunteers organized

Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation.

Sending many thanks to everyone who contributed ahead of the first FEC deadline of the election year. With our primary election behind us, those contributions will be important as we prepare for the general election in November.
I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee representing #TX07 again and it wouldn’t be possible without all the hard work #TeamLizzie put in ahead of the primary. Our campaign team will keep you informed about all the ways you can help, but for now, I just want to say how grateful I am to have you on #TeamLizzie. Thank you!
Together, we can do anything,

Peter,
Later this month will be one year since Kirsten launched her campaign for Congress.
It’s been a big year. Since launching, we’ve been endorsed by countless incredible organizations, including Planned Parenthood, EMILY’s List, Giffords PAC, the Sierra Club, Reproductive Freedom for All, the Arizona ALF-CIO, and End Citizens United — as well as by leaders like Senator Mark Kelly, House Minority Whip Katherine Clark, and Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes.
We’re thrilled to have their support, and it’s been critical to our momentum. But grassroots supporters like you have always been the heart of our campaign.
Our campaign is about people who want good-paying jobs, strong public schools for their kids, affordable housing and healthcare, and protection of their fundamental freedoms, like our reproductive rights.
That’s why Kirsten wants to hear from you.
Will you help us kick off the new quarter by completing our 2024 issue survey? Hearing from you on the issues that matter most helps Kirsten shape what she talks about on the campaign trail >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4PyF-2L_sE6RoKtKuhkvcw2]
FILL OUT OUR ISSUE SURVEY [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4PyF-2L_sE6RoKtKuhkvcw2]

Team Engel

By Putin and the Russian military, yes. Every day Ukrainian troops are under attack and Ukrainian civilians are at risk.
But they’re also under attack here in the United States. Trump is hellbent on stopping the flow of aid to Ukraine. After weeks of posturing and teasing a move to act on American support for Ukraine — critically needed humanitarian and military support — Speaker Johnson backed into his corner.
Speaker Johnson is **AGAIN** delaying the bipartisan National Security package that would fully fund Ukraine’s fight against Putin. The bipartisan package that the Senate passed months ago.
Power concedes nothing without a demand. We must make this situation politically untenable for Johnson and the MAGA-right. We must raise our voices and demand that the House put Ukraine aid to a vote.

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Five days in Wisconsin
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Hi Peter,

One of my favorite parts about serving the people of Wisconsin is getting
to travel across our state, meet with folks from different communities,
and have conversations about the most pressing issues they’re facing.

So you can imagine how excited I was to complete my statewide Dairyland
Tour, a 1,400-mile road trip across 19 counties — and all seasons! Here
are some highlights from my time on the road:

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin on her Dairyland Tour

I kicked off my Dairyland Tour in Northern Wisconsin with a stop in
Superior. We were met with heavy snow, but that didn’t stop us! In fact,
our very first stop was to thank the incredible snowplow operators who
kept the roads clear and safe for those of us traveling.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin thanking snowplow operators in Superior

I also stopped by a local small business, Thirsty Pagan Brewing, to sit
down with Superior Mayor Jim Paine and talk about our work to expand
broadband in every corner of our state.

On our way to Ashland, we took a quick detour to visit one of my favorite
coffee shops in Washburn and catch up on a few emails. There’s nothing
like a hot cup of coffee to keep us fueled during a winter storm!

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin sitting down for a cup of coffee

The next morning, I hosted a roundtable with Bad River Tribe leaders to
discuss the work I’m doing to address disparities in health care for
Native communities in Wisconsin. I also got the chance to tour the major
expansion underway that will continue providing high-quality care for
community members.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin touring a major expansion underway to provide care to
Native communities

Then, we drove down to Rhinelander to meet up with our fabulous Oneida and
Vilas County supporters.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin meeting up with Oneida and Vilas County supporters in
Rhinelander

I started the next day in Marathon County for a Main Street walk. After
visiting a few small businesses in Wausau, we drove to Appleton to tour
BenShot’s glass workshop and talked about the importance of supporting
Made in Wisconsin small businesses.

I ended my day in Jefferson County for a meet-and-greet event with our
incredible grassroots supporters!

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1009&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin at a meet-and-greet event with supporters in Jefferson
County

The next day, we toured the famous New Glarus Brewing Company — one of my
favorite stops of our Dairyland tour.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1010&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin touring the famous New Glarus Brewing Company

Then, we made the trip to Richland Center to visit Main Street small
businesses before catching up with Vernon County supporters to talk about
the issues that matter most.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1011&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin visiting Main Street small businesses in Richland

On the final day of our tour, I hosted a roundtable discussion with the
Farmer Angel Network — a Sauk County organization dedicated to helping our
farmers and rural communities access the mental health care resources they
need.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1012&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]Tammy Baldwin with the Farmer Angel Network in Sauk County

That’s a wrap! I’m taking everything I heard back to Washington to find
solutions for Wisconsinites in every corner of our state. Every person I
meet and conversation I have keeps me energized to do this work. I
couldn’t be more grateful for everyone who met us on the road — thank you,
Wisconsin!

But the truth is, I can’t do it alone — and I’ll need your support to keep
fighting for the people of Wisconsin in the Senate.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240405_AM1_V1_S1&t=1013&akid=2361%2E35263%2EN2om_x ]So,
Peter,
will you chip in to help me keep up the fight for Wisconsinites in the
U.S. Senate? I’m in the midst of my most competitive and expensive
reelection campaign ever, and I’m counting on your support today.

clean_body: [ ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE Hi Peter, One of my favorite parts about serving the people of Wisconsin is getting to travel across our state, meet with folks from different communities, and have conversations about the most pressing issues they’re facing. So you can imagine how excited I was to complete my statewide Dairyland Tour, a 1,400-mile road trip across 19 counties — and all seasons! Here are some highlights from my time on the road: [ ]Tammy Baldwin on her Dairyland Tour I kicked off my Dairyland Tour in Northern Wisconsin with a stop in Superior. We were met with heavy snow, but that didn’t stop us! In fact, our very first stop was to thank the incredible snowplow operators who kept the roads clear and safe for those of us traveling. [ ]Tammy Baldwin thanking snowplow operators in Superior I also stopped by a local small business, Thirsty Pagan Brewing, to sit down with Superior Mayor Jim Paine and talk about our work to expand broadband in every corner of our state. On our way to Ashland, we took a quick detour to visit one of my favorite coffee shops in Washburn and catch up on a few emails. There’s nothing like a hot cup of coffee to keep us fueled during a winter storm! [ ]Tammy Baldwin sitting down for a cup of coffee The next morning, I hosted a roundtable with Bad River Tribe leaders to discuss the work I’m doing to address disparities in health care for Native communities in Wisconsin. I also got the chance to tour the major expansion underway that will continue providing high-quality care for community members. [ ]Tammy Baldwin touring a major expansion underway to provide care to Native communities Then, we drove down to Rhinelander to meet up with our fabulous Oneida and Vilas County supporters. [ ]Tammy Baldwin meeting up with Oneida and Vilas County supporters in Rhinelander I started the next day in Marathon County for a Main Street walk. After visiting a few small businesses in Wausau, we drove to Appleton to tour BenShot’s glass workshop and talked about the importance of supporting Made in Wisconsin small businesses. I ended my day in Jefferson County for a meet-and-greet event with our incredible grassroots supporters! [ ]Tammy Baldwin at a meet-and-greet event with supporters in Jefferson County The next day, we toured the famous New Glarus Brewing Company — one of my favorite stops of our Dairyland tour. [ ]Tammy Baldwin touring the famous New Glarus Brewing Company Then, we made the trip to Richland Center to visit Main Street small businesses before catching up with Vernon County supporters to talk about the issues that matter most. [ ]Tammy Baldwin visiting Main Street small businesses in Richland On the final day of our tour, I hosted a roundtable discussion with the Farmer Angel Network — a Sauk County organization dedicated to helping our farmers and rural communities access the mental health care resources they need. [ ]Tammy Baldwin with the Farmer Angel Network in Sauk County That’s a wrap! I’m taking everything I heard back to Washington to find solutions for Wisconsinites in every corner of our state. Every person I meet and conversation I have keeps me energized to do this work. I couldn’t be more grateful for everyone who met us on the road — thank you, Wisconsin! But the truth is, I can’t do it alone — and I’ll need your support to keep fighting for the people of Wisconsin in the Senate. [ ]So, Peter, will you chip in to help me keep up the fight for Wisconsinites in the U.S. Senate? I’m in the midst of my most competitive and expensive reelection campaign ever, and I’m counting on your support today. name: Rick Coplen
subject: Greedflation, Shrinkflation, Inflation – I’ll fight them all.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen
body:
|
---
Sen. Bob Casey is right! We can fight inflation by keeping a lid on costs and making sure people get their money’s worth for whatever they buy. And, I’m quick to add again, by making sure that working people receive a living wage for their labor.

“Greedflation” happens when companies use inflation as an excuse to raise prices far beyond what they need. A perfect example is oil companies, who imposed record price increases on us at a time when they were making record profits. This was a primary cause of inflation, since every product we buy has to be transported – and because most of us still have to fill our gas tanks to get to work.

Another example of inflation is the practice of businesses reducing how much is in a package – without telling customers – but continuing to charge the same price. They get more because you get less. That’s wrong.

Sen. Casey calls this “shrinkflation,” and he’s doing something about it. He has introduced the Shrinkflation Prevention Act. It gives the Federal Trade Commission and state attorneys general the power to go after businesses that deceive consumers this way.

Scott Perry complains about inflation, but he voted against the Inflation Reduction Act! That legislation, along with sound Federal Reserve action, helped avoid a recession and continues to reduce inflation.

Scott Perry says he wants to cut the cost of government, but he still supports a $20 billion a year taxpayer subsidy for Big Oil and opposes a clean energy future that will save consumers thousands of dollars a year. For example, one of my supporters has saved $1,100 in the past year by driving an EV instead of buying gas.

**I will protect consumers and invest in a lower-cost energy future for all of us.**

body:
We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a84b37f6d4fe4b23982c7419f9cc2d49&_e=VpilCaURrJJ1ybFeQjvplDN0amk0iQvvbkPDH-qbyRNCDA7enULAsa9est7Id_AyDI_-IYUEx0rOyFzDDkEqHIhXA6SBCzL97vsnkr1RIn_rtnVqHauX7gAuJ0vSZ_5UimLohWc8UnG4vEWx5L4adT2K0sBVW8wWZZtlDBjZ0VRzDNALj-MfEicoPeU5GrbFsCtl6CH_IkC8GmqUO8--AoL7s9oZ9XcZwl4XFxH-M-njxsigHbnfldMNbP2k_MRInYXYTRF9mX_7uZx7-5clMYTnETRJyS0VYTRGAAeu9nX9rhPWD5Hu__ab1lX4NZoRRjmd8hp46-YZ-Zofa--c-t-6eEmSreRLgmEP8wTErYRclxM7qQ1757hIiyItMYVh6CqCFH3tsMcAbeIXsV2UbCLmuBCuYiKSstVFE4oRsbM%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a84b37f6d4fe4b23982c7419f9cc2d49&_e=VpilCaURrJJ1ybFeQjvplDN0amk0iQvvbkPDH-qbyRNCDA7enULAsa9est7Id_AyDI_-IYUEx0rOyFzDDkEqHIhXA6SBCzL97vsnkr1RIn_rtnVqHauX7gAuJ0vSZ_5UimLohWc8UnG4vEWx5L4adT2K0sBVW8wWZZtlDBjZ0VRzDNALj-MfEicoPeU5GrbFsCtl6CH_IkC8GmqUO8--AoL7s9oZ9XcZwl4XFxH-M-njxsigHbnfldMNbP2k_MRInYXYTRF9mX_7uZx7-5clMeIBTmdKc3fUMicWGI-FtxdpCBs4UM34bcUSHdUQF8nOy2hpOUv5Ap7zsJpHTCeSO4aZACEZzybW3puJEjyXjVK7X-JNX68ZxlBl3hoxL7iaqqQaOeyfNLaKzmscQYPKGB2T07xfR8WLGjAwMJTMQzs%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That 's why I'm calling for reinforcements. **

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that 's preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a84b37f6d4fe4b23982c7419f9cc2d49&_e=VpilCaURrJJ1ybFeQjvplDN0amk0iQvvbkPDH-qbyRNCDA7enULAsa9est7Id_AyDI_-IYUEx0rOyFzDDkEqHIhXA6SBCzL97vsnkr1RIn_rtnVqHauX7gAuJ0vSZ_5UimLohWc8UnG4vEWx5L4adT2K0sBVW8wWZZtlDBjZ0VRzDNALj-MfEicoPeU5GrbFsCtl6CH_IkC8GmqUO8--AoL7s9oZ9XcZwl4XFxH-M-njxsigHbnfldMNbP2k_MRInYXYTRF9mX_7uZx7-5clMWKhJskb_6q5AL0cDO6KxXqQe0yw7uMaqgaDqbS_p7C5yaUotpIhy92ILJ-Dj5SsT7xXiWnCdii5Un9aK_DdNvJmi3qm29wWXPMpBLOAo9S_gg4Y3ZF9NuE_I2TvLS8hKPllsLYu-e58y0MW3Z_CKys%3D "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

When the stakes are this high, that's what will be the difference between saving our Republican Majority and losing to the Trump-hating Democrats. So can I count on you to pitch in SOMETHING?

I was so proud to join Greg in Austin this past November for his Fight for Our Future Fest, where we celebrated the joy of this movement, took stock of the progressive victories, and recommitted ourselves to the important work ahead.
When I first ran for Congress in 2018, some folks cynically said nothing would change and that our movement was fleeting. But together, we’ve proved the pundits wrong — we made history together.
"What has changed” they ask? Everything.
Together, our A-Team has...
* Organized for student debt cancellation and pressed the Biden-Harris administration to enact this policy — and so far $138 billion has been canceled. And we’re not stopping there. We’re going to keep fighting for broad-based student debt cancellation for all borrowers.** **
* Brought home millions of dollars of federal funding — to build more affordable housing, to fund fare-free buses, to pilot free college programs, to build safe bike lanes, and more. Oh, and when conservatives recently stripped funding for LGBTQ+ senior housing in our district, we fought back and we got that funding reinstated.
* Advocated for justice for the people, from protesting on the steps of the Capitol to stop the expiration of the eviction moratorium during COVID-19, to calling for an immediate ceasefire to save lives and return hostages in Gaza.

**This is the kind of change we can make when the people closest to the pain are closest to the power, driving and informing policy-making. We CAN continue to build a future where working one job is enough, bodily autonomy is a human right, homeownership is within reach, and policies are rooted inhumanity and love — but only if we keep fighting. **
**[So Peter, I’m asking you to invest in this fight by splitting a contribution of $15 or anything you can to support my re-election campaign and Greg Casar’s campaign. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82464427/465376287/-168884169?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzU3MDg4Yi04YWYzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VfpJEtGYvaGGku1u50Sp_Ys4rLQJy_SaeaREZAjvSz0=)**
By investing in our campaign, you are affirming the dignity and worth of every person who has been left out and left behind.
You are sending a message that corporate interests should never win over working people.
You’re affirming that abortion is health care.
That a college education should move us forward, not set us back.
That Black men deserve to grow old.
That you believe that all of our children deserve a future — whether they’re in Massachusetts, Gaza, or Haiti.
That this movement is STRONG.
[**If you can, please split a donation of $15 or anything you can to support my reelection campaign and Greg’s campaign during this important moment.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82464428/465376288/-168884169?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzU3MDg4Yi04YWYzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VfpJEtGYvaGGku1u50Sp_Ys4rLQJy_SaeaREZAjvSz0=)

Thank you,
-Ayanna

| Peter,

I hope this email finds you well. Now that we’ve gotten through the first quarter of 2024, I’m reaching out today to update you on the state of our race for this November. **This email is a little longer than usual, but here are the main things you should know:**

I know many of you have been supporting me for some time now, so you know that I’m no stranger to tough races. In 2022, this race came down to just 2% points, and it was the most expensive race in the state. Republicans have been trying to flip this district since I was first elected in 2018, and they’ve been raising some major funds to try again this year.

National experts have put PA-07 on the list of “toss-ups” for the 2024 Election, which means this race could go either way. With the House majority on the line, it’s never been more important to protect vulnerable incumbents like me. **Not to mention, I have three far-right extremists vying for the nomination to defeat me, and the primary election is less than 3 weeks away (April 23!!).**

We’ll know who we’re facing in November pretty soon, and that means this race will be heating up. I know this won’t be easy, but I have grassroots supporters like you on my side, and I know we have what it takes to hold this seat.

**Meanwhile, I’ll continue focusing on the most important thing: all the work I do in Congress.** My office will continue our tradition of outstanding constituent services, I will continue to work in Washington in as bipartisan a manner as I possibly can, and I will continue to work hard on legislation focused on the issues that matter to the people of my district.

If you made it this far, thank you. I couldn’t do anything without the support of people like YOU! **I know we still have a long way to go and a lot of work to do, but I’m feeling the momentum and the grassroots support we have behind us, and I know we can win again in 2024.**

Friend,

Nevada’s housing market is in _danger._

Skyrocketing prices have not only hurt homeowners' ability to buy homes and secure their families' future, but Biden and the Democrats have increased red tape and regulations that are slowing down the building of new homes.
[DEFEND NEVADA: DONATE NOW](https://johnleeforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18876e295d2df144af23d05e5&id=c18598f545&e=91a702298f)
Approximately 85% of Nevada’s land is federally owned and managed with federal partners, including the current administration. Instead of being forced to tear down new homes that will just make the problem worse, Nevadans and businesses should be allowed to take advantage of the extra land in the state that could be put to good use.

As Mayor of North Las Vegas, I know how crucial it is for Nevadans to find a home, and feel secure in it. Bureaucracy is much too often the biggest roadblock when it comes to expanding communities, and that’s why I’m ready to take the fight to Congress. We as a state SHOULD be allowed to use unoccupied land to develop homes, grow the economy, and promote the American Dream.
[**Will you donate today to my campaign, and help me stand up for Nevada against Biden and his socialist agenda?**](https://johnleeforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18876e295d2df144af23d05e5&id=3d32091e29&e=91a702298f)

Since then, lawmakers throughout the country have introduced and passed dangerous legislation to restrict women’s reproductive rights.

While we won’t hear the final decision for some time, the arguments made before the court make clear that anti-choice activists will pursue any and all avenues to restrict **and attack our reproductive rights.**

Defending reproductive freedom for all Virginians means electing a pro-choice Governor in 2025. | = | Peter, this email is a little longer than usual, but it’s an important one. Last week, the U.S. Supreme Court heard a case challenging access to Mifepristone — an FDA-approved medication used in abortions and treatments of miscarriages. This attack on reproductive rights comes two years after the Supreme Court voted to overturn the 50-year precedent set in Roe v. Wade, leaving reproductive healthcare up to individual states to decide. Since then, lawmakers throughout the country have introduced and passed dangerous legislation to restrict women’s reproductive rights. While we won’t hear the final decision for some time, the arguments made before the court make clear that anti-choice activists will pursue any and all avenues to restrict and attack our reproductive rights. Last February, the Alabama Supreme Court's decision to restrict in vitro fertilization (IVF) underscored a broader and even more backward agenda. Virginians deserve a Governor who will always protect our fundamental rights. | | This week, I sat down with the father of a young boy tragically killed by fentanyl, a drug he had no idea he was consuming. It’s another gut-wrenching reminder of the [grim reality](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuCnqGiVcszlSeRccEW84ifkeWTrRV5BrUe4oNF4Cg651INeu05ho-VNuKzyb-8rrI9V6uaIPUA7CftYlndRM1_LBx-jz1e5h7Nw8CTRK3sqN9vYREvhnZR5BA-ylvuiCuHnBEvQAsd52JFoOziRKQ-b9_lPAnNdoyEWmBXM5dtayXcVf1SHJnfSTZnlblU97LTnrdDRPuCzpEAA5u9HD5T4qJwzo3-iFp8-a5TFxNrfweeeIrPIYYIlZTO9DtaX0r_7N7MhlLWw1nMNU4PtIl3w%3D) of our southern border crisis: Drugs are [pouring in](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuCnqGiVcszlSeRccEW84ifklBxjeGhTHrifYhPF1kOqIqAbHhTSI8Xhm7i6fPjzJ2JvUZr_1rhR6C7hxdhbY_p6YN84Aqfa_e79Zs5Nefb3PILWuZ2tV_6Lq3Hcu-N0pGtsK7pnKOHP0Kz4jGSNIcnB1JpKXuyBl8EzaAo1_sNgF3VTV0Wl8YMGZc1uNvopFVb4xfgZDn-JRV5KL-nqMkud4VCaXfWrv-VCW1GactLVQ8jtHxsh6oNettBGA1Yz0kpxfHLeU-m8eYfB3KP7vGimQlj5Qm-w9xx-hM75zmmjh), [resources](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuEJnYm1xS5WohTTs217OKJUT8EeJox89oVQ3ctCVow4X0JDeHOAHPD0Oz8VFTu8yXuwbRTjrh0o7bnuHySvHe2nnGEF0EeL9G3YulTwhxEaiPxDs9nQkUs2JQAlVkBTnDjLaGNq7lFQ57surIqqXbOVDmRty09TMwIS8Gj6eAyEAzUaVelhQMX9TlF1C8dZD6Ynx_R244WUmFEGCpr3vEdEbx6QYr8diAEjknsNzHJ7Ec29lU8djHIdgIpsbqbAy-fDm1pEy-5zANrNu85WFJb_qGGqFBrsCIZI-SrLVoBS01_g2S_4rP8X3ktYKX3lYLw%3D%3D) are running dry, and Democrats just keep looking the other way. On Easter Sunday alone, another [1,000 "gotaway" migrants](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuCnqGiVcszlSeRccEW84iflP8ilJqvnbX1cYW_EWn5Oy-SMrVegrEiQTkVzZkiPAqu9kzZ0tm-JxHgHLy8g5rZ4lm9MmR8zMS4gbzKR9oe1Q1oezpVAcUGxp71_MDx4azvSfjgP2wD2wpA0KVM3o8fUdOtrk6mkmmUvsJ4DxuyMqd9yhLXBMiycIX0AO0N5uFglvUJCdK3YutQ4d9QZDNlW-e7kI03hG7qtdmm1qTMvKHFdNcyJbhmkX3AOUwBAdK5LNnQqOa1ulB0HrhfIAPAM8mWVwWZxaKnIvda3-AOCm) waltzed right into our country without a plan or a prayer for a better life. They’re coming in droves, but America doesn’t have the means to take care of them. Democrat-run cities continue to pass the buck, [shuffling them off](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuDXY-XHCEe1gU0i-k1bM5rJRuyYm_6aC-g31UuLASY1Pjq2O3W1K40EqJ3_sdxqb7A7TKUbgqmXXHBpspqIJuvsQgvEuhquDbPN1oBsdytAXiEjg9o1YUJ9slBgq2GUEvteBDQOX-86aZjSAUCoT2ySO9jrEA0LnWG6aO96bE5h9agqGskrB8py0a5HHvtsOAm_smSD5oTTzVA4swlcNshnTIHuK4Sal1AGjl_BfzUiJFCsxoMA8jy7uVwvyILZe8q1uCpoljokxKUosJV6VPB9541UEYAdkNZNcI7RTzQtw) to other places and bearing no responsibility for the chaos their party created. In Denver, they’re trying to convince migrants to hit the road and [head somewhere else](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuC0_Olw2S77rp4ygG2UlfRMk2IfSCpOapNatOv3WXi23rkog5WxxwPXePrNXJOF5kLLzzhxaI9EADOfvwtrJJYg9e1rwPjBj2vL3-mpboBYM2QQOdFelHaDLEjwGWnSEjaeQD_7ovklalm5rGEse3KmRD_XC0ztNgJyFwc_6QdC_4jjnH7bHdCZfHKIVcBns4VgWai0_-a_Yly5xlkR3dFuelK68Ds9fPH1r3zquM01GfbYZRerJA4WfdS6iJjplgWJpJSQjAEaF2Cmln2xhYespxYfjoC8vgb8KEYvS2Ksg)—but we’re just going around in circles here, folks. No matter where they end up, the crisis remains. Instead of closing the dadgum border, liberals prefer pandering to their radical base without any regard for who gets hurt in the process. Take Boston, where they’re turning an [old veterans’ home](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuCnqGiVcszlSeRccEW84iflNOSNITyCPRMCoGHFMHiRnkUR-CYwqYsXraBK6QQ2ehvg79DgVVDr9BFA5_OW6JuH2_Z2gVh6QPFZtAyueElT75W-A5DMEHme6tCOCtD448qGgCgHh6QXqn55A86WeJMmTeQqSvcXpshRO4yTY99vEwlLhj3EOSfn2NC7nd_YNRk18C8VHU9PO6onobdLtkKl1iG3ZxHq8DnNzwhgLVrrGnfyBN7ZkoYWouNokPJuYi1ChYWBXtOt3XAShYslLpTKX8XTq6wcyLSP9_a_I2F7z) into a shelter for migrants while [hundreds of Massachusetts vets](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuBIqJCjUhhJQW1GneDKm-8TqD2PCGZDlb7ztrk4EWDdWHtQuM_Br-b06_90Jt-hvEeUQzMkeY5VPugWKKo9CRz9NTuGJlVosRlu_YHPal7NECmOzyImxjKcu1oI6xx7B5wCto5hw5thVSATNi6DxWUd7pnhjcyS7adLLSXHLX8NYo0fVctQTkLz_oPFFHQup3wRyLLHTW-C_I2eQz4scjllyPAtJY8tYM4rLs0zSLeL8DXoDjb4WlFZ153lRKMK8XUTAEg51n7aDH8YhOVK-p1a-juv1v6oBi2R0CTGzu1aD3XuyyPHIBF8g9sutWE6aKQ%3D%3D) still experience homelessness on any given night. In New York, they’re doling out cash to illegal immigrants like there’s no tomorrow. A migrant family of four gets [$1,400 ](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuEJnYm1xS5WohTTs217OKJWwvAvP1Gz3rFTVwQRO3h6yRsxYVSXU6YeunBEWUYAEfFn3z2S9Gfb-gDlUSAA258FdguEuguOh2xX4cTdyLWc531lYFxLoigd8AsuGgAWEqw_6YKKkAglXbr8vcRlmNgxJ75I22V3P_yyBtkf4fOOdIgj3ws6vTbDj9TfyisZyljj7PhZtvwUmNyAqXQ7VXSoyFltvrhcmkS5rw7Bu8A3LhdkVQuq2xuaYETWAxwyqVw1DwV9w6dQAD1jWMzDJayE%3D)every month—more than what disabled veterans or Americans on food stamps receive. The headlines keep pouring in, and immigration is now the [number one concern](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=3086ad27988743138186ee6b989b38c8&_e=JnPt8_rEWCVNEKuqA1qIuNCgdmM9TMQ-TMCULbrUvAT-3tnn-uHSjDjOYzqOBoYEznRwEWDHnl1kiIbQaK7tuFJziSLcI2OmL3eLQm73GV3tE6w2FEuSoImmAsqkFSMAqzu-7wBuP-eLYFp07IRmlpzz-q7DDOmFzpxxj9I__cxF_-v04PB1T8KzXSQdoxZHXPRZZMbiMRMecmtNYh05ZrueHd2lvBmdqe9priTQ9f4hflg5PP13BCHSMck9KHBecGOFLfHdMkgJKLsmDLgw5EkBCb5r0EbBi85wVBBQB60ffjE-D6v7or91Cmy_Tri9) for Americans who will head to the ballot box this November. But if we’re serious about fixing this mess, we have to get out there and vote for tried-and-true conservatives all the way down the ballot. From your city council to your state Senate, I hope you’ll leave no stone unturned. It's time we wake up, get fired up, and take our country back—or there’s no telling how much worse this will get.

| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e40b05682a3440629b7b89aaeefa3ef4&_e=R3D4r_RmRs__KYIamsWxItapOqbZ0f7pTbbnIksvupRI9Y7opAayqnRAYlg_M3sBhGcRoWZyBak_N9tV2b1rotrKLJV5ywOMRW8h2xIAKf-A4INQjf0RGGIwp-bmKAwOhxtQVDV5HIJugh7nX3MhHAhDizzx8Sq9h4CHuHqcdWpWpe3S8yOvy3uDPhjW5q_fH4RMsMo06lulGufwZ0gLND7idU7U2ab3KKCsce0Dg9EN4Dy1shxIx1f6BMAC81UuaGInieoGtTOswWa5UQBon1ec3Cnx3jmIRxOmOf9Z1lkVCaoc0FPO_6eyelTTOJNYoVL8uZc2DTQqu9gKtmODJsBAV0jUN_NAbOdvYO-TfuOBe2BpAV6uDga0y5m0024fC-n5TFZh1iNMIByCIBhZa5Sw1EOnsWkr9zZBJoR71II%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e40b05682a3440629b7b89aaeefa3ef4&_e=R3D4r_RmRs__KYIamsWxItapOqbZ0f7pTbbnIksvupRI9Y7opAayqnRAYlg_M3sBhGcRoWZyBak_N9tV2b1rotrKLJV5ywOMRW8h2xIAKf-A4INQjf0RGGIwp-bmKAwOhxtQVDV5HIJugh7nX3MhHAhDizzx8Sq9h4CHuHqcdWpWpe3S8yOvy3uDPhjW5q_fH4RMsMo06lulGufwZ0gLND7idU7U2ab3KKCsce0Dg9EN4Dy1shxIx1f6BMAC81UuaGInieoGtTOswWa5UQBonzaRmhlgv56EXj4WyY9j9fyD7Met_aRvNVzYyK0HFZUPlM6yOQPvx8pLq71YYOGIko8OmerheH-pgjyLEouM1oSPKm12U7PBQAhQi0fCJTmfi0Kd4n-19v1kU6X_-IpX3VBTP8MWaC_QHVDGHxPk_Rs%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

clean_body: The GOP is all too happy to crack down on fundamental human rights when it comes to any group of people they don’t like or want to control. David’s right, Peter. Republicans talk a big game about promoting “freedom,” but they’re all too happy to crack down on fundamental human rights when it comes to any group of people they don’t like or want to control: Let’s recap what Republicans have prioritized in the last few years: Bans on abortion in dozens of states, often with no exceptions at all Bans on transition-related medical care for trans people Bans on IVF treatment for people trying to have children Bans on books in public schools And that’s just the highlights. They’ve also undermined voting rights and floated bizarre ideas like ending no-fault divorce and restricting travel for pregnant people. The Republican Party is anything but the party of freedom — and stopping them at the polls this November is critical if we truly want to defend the freedoms we hold dear. Leaders We Deserve is working to do that by supporting fantastic young candidates all over the country, but we’re a grassroots organization that depends on your support to get the job done. Thanks, Leaders We Deserve HQ

Government programs are always more expensive than politicians claim, and medicaid expansion is no different.
1. **Initial Projections vs. Reality:** The initial projections of costs for Medicaid expansion were significantly lower than the actual costs incurred. For instance, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) had projected that the adults newly eligible for Medicaid under the ACA would cost less to insure, on average, than other non-elderly adults already on the program. However, actual costs have exceeded these initial projections, with per enrollee spending on expansion adults being significantly higher than expected [ ([https://www.openhealthpolicy.com/post/those-covered-under-medicaid-expansion-are-costing-much-more-than-expected](https://substack.com/redirect/ca390188-3776-40a3-a415-70010a7ec4e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))].
2. **Higher Per Enrollee Costs:** The gap between the expected costs and actual costs has been widening over time. In 2022, the last year in the CMS projection window, expansion adults were expected to cost $4,875 per enrollee, while other non-elderly adults were expected to cost $7,195 per enrollee, nearly 50% more. This indicates a significant underestimation of the costs associated with the expansion [ ([https://www.openhealthpolicy.com/post/those-covered-under-medicaid-expansion-are-costing-much-more-than-expected)](https://substack.com/redirect/3b0e23d9-ecd9-4e3c-97f1-54cc106e87b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)].
3. **Inaccurate Enrollment Projections:** The enrollment explosion in expansion states has also contributed to the higher-than-expected costs. Estimates by various think tanks and government agencies, including the Congressional Budget Office, have consistently underestimated how many able-bodied adults would enroll if states expanded Medicaid, leading to skyrocketing costs for taxpayers [ ([https://thefga.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/How-the-ObamaCare-dependency-crisis-could-get-even-worse-%E2%80%94-and-how-to-stop-it-1-15-18.pdf](https://substack.com/redirect/99e68286-9ba4-4fd9-9744-f47a86109911?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))].
4. **Unsustainable Budget Effects:** The actual experience of expansion states shows that the initial per-capita cost came in much higher than expected, with new reports showing that the costs of newly eligible adults are 19% higher than non-newly eligible adults [ ([www.mercatus.org](https://substack.com/redirect/9ccd83b9-0b22-4603-91cd-9b156277085d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))].
5. **Misclassifications and Ineligible Enrollees:** Audits in states that expanded Medicaid, such as California, New York, and Colorado, have suggested that about 10-25% of enrollees classified as newly eligible under the ACA are, in fact, either ineligible for coverage or misclassified. This artificially inflates per enrollee spending in the newly eligible group [ ([https://www.openhealthpolicy.com/post/those-covered-under-medicaid-expansion-are-costing-much-more-than-expected)](https://substack.com/redirect/3b0e23d9-ecd9-4e3c-97f1-54cc106e87b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)].

These factors combined have led to Medicaid expansion being more expensive than most people initially thought.

When you hired me as State Treasurer in 2020, I made a promise - now I’m ready to do it again as your next U.S. Representative for West Virginia Congressional District 2.

| [](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=6d22709097854fb3bf5e3bf98d56c310&_e=826B0VcFYV-g9SAR5ciA5lZ9DlDzaF8xzFsoLM94z61ub92DRbk78f4YOVV4uCrl2WxcPSLrlIiXpxrYbG6RPq3fo1FCtWwdbreSF7m96uhD1At7iQBTams89SFikd7UTmIVVnOhSrl7pi53z2pIkEvvTJTkoTo4gF_NpEe5cZoJ_75R4lvlC6jla0Ng2jaT3zhCXEjjgJ3fxcduWbQyqTSCo6fNKgILLjvJMJbTHv9Vu8OwDkwJw_xQ9hwGfCKvjxDs_wql4Pt-nGLxdYKDPP6SFc3dNQmhqPvDfoPxZooT1kVBkzl7pohf52yzYGxew-0IeQE5ffOCsJ51gxrWlf-S3ZGA8va5lh8rNOfxr6TRLLv2Z-ubr8KhP_DBHzCAkFBJK8Cgg5ah7ssJ1Ichvw%3D%3D)
---
Fellow American,

I made a promise when you hired me as State Treasurer four years ago. As the next U.S. Representative for West Virginia’s 2nd Congressional District (God willing), I’m ready to do it again.

I promised you that I would get to work for all West Virginians and deliver on our shared goals; goals that will take our state from good to great, and make it the best place for people to live, work, and raise their families.

As I run for a new office, I promise to continue pushing West Virginia to be the best it can be. I’m prepared to fight for you by working to:

* Decrease inflation and put hard-earned dollars back into the pockets of Americans

* Invest in our teachers and children so the next generation can reach their full potential (no more CRT curriculum in schools)

* Put our economy back on track & get folks back to work

* Secure our border to STOP the drugs, crime, and human trafficking poisoning our communities

* Support law enforcement and our military, who work to keep us safe at home and overseas

| [**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=6d22709097854fb3bf5e3bf98d56c310&_e=826B0VcFYV-g9SAR5ciA5lZ9DlDzaF8xzFsoLM94z61ub92DRbk78f4YOVV4uCrl2WxcPSLrlIiXpxrYbG6RPq3fo1FCtWwdbreSF7m96uhD1At7iQBTams89SFikd7UTmIVVnOhSrl7pi53z2pIkEvvTJTkoTo4gF_NpEe5cZoJ_75R4lvlC6jla0Ng2jaTufeyW11JYByOVYaYSdA3qptgOszBsJWKKbeM_ChCMKDFJDBdnO2H3kOSJZfbrnqzC7RCCQpFUxT12wBrLM0dRqO1xn4W9XUo0xCOOK6WjYxbf3HnYbW-wz2HttozAs53xlrO_SRFbNkAWH_SaT1RL7Uvga87NF7XdJ0M_E-4L1zo-FO9Gzc7OikDISuqafeLERPjaXqIKhrHHQCloxXylg%3D%3D)
---

We can do all of this together, not because of partisan views, but because we know these common sense solutions will deliver the best results for all of West Virginia and America.

All of these shared goals are at risk from the far Left Democrats who are trying to take control of the House, Senate, and White House in 2024. They are trying to lead West Virginia and America down a path toward higher taxes, higher crime, higher inflation, unsafe communities, and fewer jobs.

As your next Congressman, I refuse to let that happen. I’m not going to stand by and let them steal your paychecks and raise your taxes to fund their bogus plans. I’m not going to let our border remain wide open and crime flood into our communities. I’m not going to let them take jobs out of West Virginia.

I promise to find common-sense solutions to defend West Virginia and prevent the Left from tearing apart the American Dream even further. I appreciate your support as I aim to deliver on these promises.

[**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=6d22709097854fb3bf5e3bf98d56c310&_e=826B0VcFYV-g9SAR5ciA5lZ9DlDzaF8xzFsoLM94z61ub92DRbk78f4YOVV4uCrl2WxcPSLrlIiXpxrYbG6RPq3fo1FCtWwdbreSF7m96uhD1At7iQBTams89SFikd7UTmIVVnOhSrl7pi53z2pIkEvvTJTkoTo4gF_NpEe5cZoJ_75R4lvlC6jla0Ng2jaTufeyW11JYByOVYaYSdA3qptgOszBsJWKKbeM_ChCMKAyEmiSL1ggze7pkiqE15s4zQeAABgqwS9gk6BOrnWiNOoMEyxaFJsb5mHXRwm43wnyHj9F_qe8iCQ_fJhr_pxeQwqCYcatCU3qOk-mgpsxn_HhZbveiYs4JxHmWALJaIb2JQs53p1fm_kLK9E71oiVPjTZX_BZErC5SLdQT8tGug%3D%3D)
---

Thank you for your support,

Riley Moore

|
**RILEY MOORE: CONSERVATIVE FOR CONGRESS.**

* * *
Washington is all tied up in putting politics over principle.
It’s time to put a stop to it and start putting PRINCIPLES OVER POLITICS - starting with YOU!

As the next U.S. Representative for West Virginia’s 2nd Congressional District (God willing), I’m ready to do it again. I promised you that I would get to work for all West Virginians and deliver on our shared goals; goals that will take our state from good to great, and make it the best place for people to live, work, and raise their families. As I run for a new office, I promise to continue pushing West Virginia to be the best it can be. I’m prepared to fight for you by working to: Decrease inflation and put hard-earned dollars back into the pockets of Americans Invest in our teachers and children so the next generation can reach their full potential (no more CRT curriculum in schools) Put our economy back on track & get folks back to work Secure our border to STOP the drugs, crime, and human trafficking poisoning our communities Support law enforcement and our military, who work to keep us safe at home and overseas | We can do all of this together, not because of partisan views, but because we know these common sense solutions will deliver the best results for all of West Virginia and America. All of these shared goals are at risk from the far Left Democrats who are trying to take control of the House, Senate, and White House in 2024. They are trying to lead West Virginia and America down a path toward higher taxes, higher crime, higher inflation, unsafe communities, and fewer jobs. As your next Congressman, I refuse to let that happen. I’m not going to stand by and let them steal your paychecks and raise your taxes to fund their bogus plans. I’m not going to let our border remain wide open and crime flood into our communities. I’m not going to let them take jobs out of West Virginia. I promise to find common-sense solutions to defend West Virginia and prevent the Left from tearing apart the American Dream even further. I appreciate your support as I aim to deliver on these promises. Thank you for your support, Riley Moore | RILEY MOORE: CONSERVATIVE FOR CONGRESS. Washington is all tied up in putting politics over principle. It’s time to put a stop to it and start putting PRINCIPLES OVER POLITICS - starting with YOU! | Paid for by Moore for West Virginia. **Please watch our campaign’s brand new TV ad holding him accountable, then** [please split a donation of whatever you can afford between Defeat Republicans and my campaign so we can keep this message in front of voters. ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82473846/465393535/-1111319082?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240403_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRiMzlkYWE0LTlhZjMtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=U5uL_cxjtCE0mI3iWoxxHsT0ZX6YqnAi7R8aU9R7tOM=)

We cannot give up the fight for Rebecca and must move on to the appeal process. **[But I need your help to keep going. **Rebecca will be sentenced on August 12 th. She faces a sentence of up to three years in federal prison and fines of up to $210,000.**

VOTE RYAN MACKENZIE APRIL 23rd

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

DATE: April 5, 2024

CONTACT: press@mackenzieforcongress.com

MACKENZIE ENDORSED BY THE NATIONAL RIFLE ASSOCIATION

(LOWER MACUNGIE, PA) State Representative Ryan Mackenzie, Republican candidate for Congress in Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District today announced that he has received the important Endorsement from the National Rifle Association (NRA). This follows on the heels of being Recommended by Firearms Owners Against Crime (FOAC).

The other Republicans received ratings from the NRA but Ryan Mackenzie was the ONLY ONE ENDORSED by the NRA.

Ryan Mackenzie is the only candidate who is both Endorsed by the NRA and Recommended by FOAC.

“I thank the NRA for recognizing my proven record of standing strong for the 2nd Amendment with their endorsement. The NRA’s support sends a strong message to voters that I am the best candidate to protect and preserve the rights of law-abiding gun owners,” said Mackenzie. “As an America First conservative, the support of important groups like the NRA and FOAC show there is truly only one choice when it comes to these issues.”

body:
We knew it was rigged, we knew what they were after, and yesterday the leftist D.C. bar issued their first “disciplinary” ruling. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=17913c7d6d&u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5fae9a4618)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

Last summer my friend and CRA colleague, Jeffrey Clark, was indicted alongside President Trump and others in Georgia as part of a 2020 election case.

**But the persecution hasn’t stopped there**. Now they’re using lawfare to try and take away his law license and malign his character.

For the past two weeks, the D.C. bar has made Jeff Clark stand for a grueling sham trial, stripping him of his due process rights–like legal privileges, etc.–in their attempt to **strip him of his ability to practice law and feed his family**. The Swamp did the same thing to John Eastman earlier this week. This is choreographed.

**Friends,[ a donation of whatever you can afford](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=933b5046ab&e=17913c7d6d) to support Jeff during these attacks would go a very long way in helping the Center stand by Jeff through this persecution. **
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=2f7521d501&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| It’s also the first time in U.S. history that the D.C. bar is attempting to strip the law license from a lawyer simply for doing his job. Keep in mind, this is the same bar that is allowing Hunter Biden to have his law license, despite multiple serious indictments.

If you were to catch any of the last two weeks, you would have heard day after day, witness after witness, outline many issues with the 2020 election, and the uni-party (both the Democrat prosecutor as well as former Trump lawyers like Rosen, Donoghue, and Philbin) lie about Jeff and President Trump on the stand as well as mock the idea that the President is in charge of the DOJ. (Which is why we found it so important to outline why this is not true earlier this year.)

**Jeff needs[ our help](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=29fe8efe72&e=17913c7d6d). **

We knew it was rigged, we knew what they were after, and yesterday the leftist D.C. bar issued their first “disciplinary” ruling saying Jeff violated his code of conduct in his work fighting for the integrity of our elections in 2020. It’s the first major step towards disbarring and stripping Jeff of his ability to practice law.

This was my statement yesterday when the news broke.
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=130ff1176f&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| The truth is, Jeff is a brave patriot and brilliant legal mind and has done paradigm-shifting work at the Center for Renewing America.

That’s why they’re after him. He is a clear and present threat to the leftist legal establishment and they will stop at nothing until he is barred from practicing law.

I hope you will support and stand by Jeff. [A donation of $25, $50, $100 can go a long way](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=51cd106691&e=17913c7d6d).

_Jeff isn’t backing down, so neither can we_.
---
| Sincerely,

****
Russ Vought
President, Center for Renewing America

subject: Shop green this Earth Day
body:
Reduce your impact, max out your savings |
---

** **
|
There are many ways to celebrate Earth Day, and here at the LCV Shop, we want to make it easier for every day to be Earth Day. Using eco-friendly products and shopping sustainably is something anyone can take part in.

It's no secret that eco-friendly products can offer a way to reduce, reuse, and recycle that considers the life cycle of products from purchase to disposal. LCV Shop products display messages on vital environmental issues such as clean water, national parks, and democracy, but there's even more than meets the eye. Our products also incorporate sustainability down to the fibers, in the way they are made and the partners who make them. With organic or recycled materials, union partners, or U.S. production, the LCV Shop aims to protect people and the planet and ensure a healthy environment for future generations.

**This month, we 're spotlighting just a handful of products that help turn each day into Earth Day. Shop your values with the LCV Shop! By carrying reusable shopping bags, buying organic, or choosing products made with non-toxic chemicals and sustainable practices, you can make a huge difference doing what may seem like a small act. **

Friend,

When you hired me two years ago, I made a promise.

I promised that I would go to work for all Virginians and deliver on a shared vision that takes our great Commonwealth forward to become the best place to live, work, and raise a family.

Together, we have climbed closer and closer to that goal... to that shining city on a hill where we know Virginia should be:

We delivered $5 billion in tax relief, because your hard-earned money belongs to you and not the government.

We made record investments in our students and our teachers, so Virginia's next generation can realize their full potential with a best-in-class education.

We put parents back at the head seat of the table in their children's lives, because that's where parents belong.

We started to transform our behavioral health system to get Virginians struggling with mental health challenges the right help, right now.

We backed our law enforcement heroes with pay raises and the resources they need to keep us safe. | [ **STAND WITH GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN** ](http://links.freeliberty.co/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=805ddb49d27f4cd5b04488b8ed42b0d3&_e=da7RUKSWcrHAwcJAn27hsdzBYfAG0KH-raKdU8Q7IHtBOnX-76lS9S3fydpuAoRvUQ7ZK2YNSLi8iS967keJ1bgVbWEe4MBC15RMyvJaUf74rkObFQmQ8tkwCCNNThSE_R2n2HdMf8VMv7RVxkE22Z7QiHDsPLZ24tZshRa_gJiNjj7sat6f_eLBYJgxIoOsaqszuRkNKGD_DLch0aFwHPGXDo04Oy_phf42wdHfcdHKStTjaqweTHf0VnZpNmSFSTETRLXCgqTap6uQkmBkl83n-bDWkjQ_SLe0erdyQX_d3B0m-WeVrFGU7AF_KqH9asVhA0w9C3jYZo8JgisV5ni66rjd1Ef9JEKO83tUMb7gjHOc3mKwkMKXD0dzHgIEtvCywio6f37SY9q5yRlnVA%3D%3D)
---

We did all of this, together, not based on a partisan agenda but because we know that commonsense solutions deliver the best results for Virginia.

But all that progress threatens to be undone by far-left Democrats who barely control our General Assembly. They are trying to lead Virginia down a path toward higher taxes, fewer jobs, unsafe communities, and a stagnant economy.

As your Governor, I am not going to let that happen. I am not going to let them steal from your paychecks and raise your taxes. I am not going to let them put violent criminals back on our streets. I am not going to let them drive economic opportunity and jobs away from the Commonwealth.

I was elected to find commonsense solutions to propel Virginia forward. I promise to use my veto pen to protect Virginians from taxation and bad policies, and I appreciate your support as I deliver on the promise I made when you hired me.

[ **STAND WITH GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN** ](http://links.freeliberty.co/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=805ddb49d27f4cd5b04488b8ed42b0d3&_e=da7RUKSWcrHAwcJAn27hsdzBYfAG0KH-raKdU8Q7IHtBOnX-76lS9S3fydpuAoRvUQ7ZK2YNSLi8iS967keJ1bgVbWEe4MBC15RMyvJaUf74rkObFQmQ8tkwCCNNThSE_R2n2HdMf8VMv7RVxkE22Z7QiHDsPLZ24tZshRa_gJiNjj7sat6f_eLBYJgxIoOsaqszuRkNKGD_DLch0aFwHPGXDo04Oy_phf42wdHfcdHKStTjaqweTHf0VnZpNmSFW3o9Eps0Ng-PZz-OEjGUzMEMrVQNm30i4NIl_Q1nxpUcvtwMFlZyTi0oonipFksR1Oft-67buj9YrwpN9F9BKh1etcR9zuq7szSuSd-PL8eBnGJmK0buIAKz8lZgN-W7uyk_HvogQiwDwAO7SRc-Uw%3D%3D)
